  // View counts (simulated with localStorage persistence)
  var ptViews = {};
  try { ptViews = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bdz_views') || '{}'); } catch(e){}
  function ptSaveViews(){ try { localStorage.setItem('bdz_views', JSON.stringify(ptViews)); } catch(e){} }
  function getViewCount(id) {
    var base = {1:1247,2:892,3:2341,4:673,5:1102,6:534,7:887,8:723,9:1056};
    return (base[id]||500) + (ptViews[id]||0);
  }
  function formatViews(n) {
    if(n >= 1000) return (n/1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return n.toString();
  }

  // Particle system for portrait modal
  function startParticles() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('ptParticles');
    if(!canvas) return;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    var particles = [];
    var goldColor = ptCurrent ? ptCurrent.glow : '#EFB20C';
    
    for(var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        vy: -Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.1,
        size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
        alpha: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1,
        life: Math.random() * 200 + 100
      });
    }
    
    function animate() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(function(p) {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.life--;
        if(p.life <= 0 || p.y < -10) {
          p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
          p.y = canvas.height + 10;
          p.life = Math.random() * 200 + 100;
          p.alpha = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = goldColor;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * (p.life > 30 ? 1 : p.life / 30);
        ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ptParticleAnim = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
  }
  
  function stopParticles() {
    if(ptParticleAnim) { cancelAnimationFrame(ptParticleAnim); ptParticleAnim = null; }
    var canvas = document.getElementById('ptParticles');
    if(canvas) { var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); }
  }

  function openPortrait(p) {
    document.body.classList.add('video-playing');
    ptCurrent = p;
    // Increment view count
    ptViews[p.id] = (ptViews[p.id] || 0) + 1;
    ptSaveViews();
    
    var bg = document.getElementById('ptCardBg');
    if(bg) bg.style.background = p.clr;
    var vbd = document.getElementById('ptVideoBackdrop');
    if(vbd){
      if(p.thumb){ vbd.style.background = '#000'; vbd.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + p.thumb + '")'; }
      else { vbd.style.backgroundImage = 'none'; vbd.style.background = p.clr; }
    }
    var glow = document.getElementById('ptCardGlow');
    if(glow) glow.style.background = p.glow;
    var glow2 = document.getElementById('ptCardGlow2');
    if(glow2) glow2.style.background = p.glow;
    
    var el = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
    var catLabel = (p.cat||'').replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase();
    var c = el('ptCat'); if(c) c.textContent = catLabel + ' PROJECT';
    var t = el('ptTitle'); if(t) t.textContent = p.name;
    var cl = el('ptClient'); if(cl) cl.textContent = p.client;
    var d = el('ptDesc'); if(d) d.textContent = p.desc;
    
    // Update view count
    var vc = el('ptViewsCount');
    if(vc) vc.textContent = formatViews(getViewCount(p.id)) + ' views';
    
    // Update project counter
    var counter = el('ptCounter');
    if(counter) {
      var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
      var idx = -1;
      for(var i=0;i<navList.length;i++){ if(navList[i].id === p.id){ idx=i; break; }}
      counter.innerHTML = '<span>' + String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span> / ' + String(navList.length).padStart(2,'0');
    }
    
    // ── VIDEO PLAYER (Bunny Stream via HLS.js) — IMPROVED BUFFERING ──
    var video = el('ptVideo');
    var playBtn = el('ptPlayBtn');
    var muteBtn = el('ptMuteBtn');

    // Destroy previous HLS instance and progress bar
    if(window._hlsInstance) {
      window._hlsInstance.destroy();
      window._hlsInstance = null;
    }
    if(window._ptProgressBar) {
      window._ptProgressBar.destroy();
      window._ptProgressBar = null;
    }

    if(video) {
      video.onwaiting = null;
      video.onstalled = null;
      video.onplaying = null;
      video.ontimeupdate = null;
      video.pause();
      video.removeAttribute('src');
      video.load();
      video.style.display = 'none';
      var loader = el('ptLoader');
      if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
      if(playBtn) { playBtn.style.display = ''; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;'; }
      if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';
      if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }

      var hasVideo = p.hls || p.mp4;
      if(hasVideo) {
        video.style.display = 'block';
        video.muted = true;
        video.loop = true;

        // Initialize progress bar for this video
        window._ptProgressBar = initProgressBar(video, 'ptProgressWrap', 'ptBufferBar', 'ptPlayBar', 'ptThumb', 'ptTimeDisplay');
        if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.reset();

        // Handle stalling — let HLS.js ABR handle quality automatically
        video.onwaiting = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
          if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
          // Start monitoring buffer — only resume when enough buffer has rebuilt
          if(window._ptBufferMonitor) clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor);
          window._ptBufferMonitor = setInterval(function(){
            var lead = getBufferLead(video);
            if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_RESUME){
              clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor);
              window._ptBufferMonitor = null;
              video.play().then(function(){
                if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              }).catch(function(){});
            }
          }, 300);
        };
        video.onplaying = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
          if(playBtn) { playBtn.style.display = 'none'; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;'; }
          if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; }
          if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
          if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }
        };

        // Show branded loader during initial load
        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
        if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';

        // Use HLS.js for .m3u8 streams (Bunny Stream) — BUFFER-AWARE PLAYBACK
        if(p.hls && Hls.isSupported()) {
          var hls = new Hls({
            startLevel: -1,
            capLevelToPlayerSize: true,
            maxBufferLength: 15,
            maxMaxBufferLength: 30,
            maxBufferSize: 10 * 1000 * 1000,
            maxBufferHole: 0.3,
            backBufferLength: 30,
            lowLatencyMode: false,
            abrEwmaDefaultEstimate: 1000000,
            abrBandWidthFactor: 0.95,
            abrBandWidthUpFactor: 0.7,
            enableWorker: true,
            fragLoadingTimeOut: 20000,
            fragLoadingMaxRetry: 6,
            fragLoadingRetryDelay: 1000,
            levelLoadingTimeOut: 15000,
            startFragPrefetch: true,
            testBandwidth: true,
            stretchShortVideoTrack: true,
            nudgeOffset: 0.2,
            nudgeMaxRetry: 5
          });
          hls.loadSource(p.hls);
          hls.attachMedia(video);
          hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, function(){
            // Let HLS.js ABR auto-select best quality (startLevel: -1)
            // Wait for buffer to build before starting playback
            var ptStartCheck = setInterval(function(){
              var lead = getBufferLead(video);
              if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_START){
                clearInterval(ptStartCheck);
                video.play().then(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
                  if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._ptResetMuteIcon(); }
                  if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
                }).catch(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
                });
              }
            }, 300);
          });

          hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, function(event, data){
            if(data.fatal) {
              switch(data.type) {
                case Hls.ErrorTypes.NETWORK_ERROR:
                  hls.startLoad(); // try to recover network
                  break;
                case Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR:
                  hls.recoverMediaError(); // try to recover media
                  break;
                default:
                  // Fall back to MP4 if HLS completely fails
                  if(p.mp4) {
                    hls.destroy();
                    video.src = p.mp4;
                    video.load();
                    video.play().catch(function(){});
                  }
                  break;
              }
            }
          });
          window._hlsInstance = hls;
        }
        // Native HLS support (Safari/iOS)
        else if(p.hls && video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
          video.src = p.hls;
          video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._ptResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
            });
          }, 500);
        }
        // Direct MP4 fallback
        else if(p.mp4) {
          video.src = p.mp4;
          video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._ptResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
            });
          }, 500);
        }
      } else {
        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
        if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.hide();
      }
    }

    // Close description by default
    var desc = el('ptDesc');
    var descToggle = el('ptDescToggle');
    if(desc) desc.classList.remove('open');
    if(descToggle) descToggle.classList.remove('open');

    // Also show thumbnail as background while video loads
    if(p.thumb && bg) {
      bg.style.background = 'url(' + p.thumb + ') center/cover no-repeat';
    } else {
      if(bg) bg.style.background = p.clr;
    }
    
    // Enhanced meta
    var meta = el('ptMeta');
    if(meta){
      var metaHTML = '';
      if(p.duration) metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#9201;</span> '+p.duration+'</span>';
      metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#127916;</span> 100% AI</span>';
      if(p.badge_txt) metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">'+(BADGE_ICONS[p.badge]||'')+'</span> '+p.badge_txt+'</span>';
      meta.innerHTML = metaHTML;
    }
    var tools = el('ptTools');
    if(tools && p.tools){
      tools.innerHTML = p.tools.map(function(t){ return '<span class="pt-tool">'+t+'</span>'; }).join('');
    }
    ptUpdateLike(p.id);
    ptUpdateComment(p.id);
    
    // Show swipe hint on first visit
    var hint = el('ptSwipeHint');
    if(hint) {
      var seen = localStorage.getItem('bdz_swipe_seen');
      if(!seen) {
        hint.style.display = '';
        hint.style.animation = 'ptSwipeHint 3s ease 1.5s forwards';
        localStorage.setItem('bdz_swipe_seen', '1');
      } else {
        hint.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
    
    var m = el('ptModal');
    var _wasAlreadyOpen = m && m.classList.contains('open');
    if(m){ m.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
    
    // Push state so back button closes modal instead of leaving page — only once per open
    if(!_wasAlreadyOpen && !_ptModalHistoryPushed){
      history.pushState({ modal: 'portrait' }, '', _bdzHashUrl('bdz-player'));
      _ptModalHistoryPushed = true;
    }
    
    // Start particle animation
    setTimeout(startParticles, 300);
  }

  // Immediately stop current video playback and destroy HLS to free bandwidth
  function stopCurrentVideo() {
    document.body.classList.remove('video-playing');
    if(window._hlsInstance) { window._hlsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsInstance = null; }
    if(window._hlsLsInstance) { window._hlsLsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsLsInstance = null; }
    if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }
    if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }
    var ptVid = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
    if(ptVid) { ptVid.pause(); ptVid.removeAttribute('src'); ptVid.load(); }
    var lsVid = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
    if(lsVid) { lsVid.pause(); lsVid.removeAttribute('src'); lsVid.load(); }
  }

  // NEXT / PREV project navigation with cinematic transition
  window.nextProject = function(){
    if(!ptCurrent && !lsCurrent) return;
    stopCurrentVideo();
    var currentProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
    var idx = -1;
    for(var i=0;i<current.length;i++){ if(current[i].id === currentProject.id){ idx=i; break; }}
    if(idx === -1){ for(var i=0;i<PROJECTS.length;i++){ if(PROJECTS[i].id === currentProject.id){ idx=i; break; }} }
    var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
    var next = navList[(idx+1)%navList.length];
    var isLandscapeNext = (next.aspect === 'landscape' || next.aspect === '16:9');
    var isCurrentPortraitModal = !!ptCurrent;
    // If switching modal type, close current and open new — transfer history entry
    if(isCurrentPortraitModal && isLandscapeNext){
      _closingViaPopstate = true; // prevent history.back() on close
      closePortrait();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      _lsModalHistoryPushed = true; // transfer history ownership to landscape modal
      setTimeout(function(){ openLandscape(next); }, 100);
      return;
    }
    if(!isCurrentPortraitModal && !isLandscapeNext){
      _closingViaPopstate = true; // prevent history.back() on close
      closeLandscape();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      _ptModalHistoryPushed = true; // transfer history ownership to portrait modal
      setTimeout(function(){ openPortrait(next); }, 100);
      return;
    }
    // Same modal type — animate transition
    if(isCurrentPortraitModal){
      var card = document.querySelector('.pt-modal-card');
      if(card){
        card.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        card.style.transform = 'translateY(-30px)';
        card.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function(){
          openPortrait(next);
          card.style.transition = 'none';
          card.style.transform = 'translateY(30px)';
          card.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(function(){
            card.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            card.style.transform = '';
            card.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openPortrait(next); }
    } else {
      var lsCard = document.querySelector('.ls-modal-card');
      if(lsCard){
        lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(30px)';
        lsCard.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function(){
          openLandscape(next);
          lsCard.style.transition = 'none';
          lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(-30px)';
          lsCard.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(function(){
            lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            lsCard.style.transform = '';
            lsCard.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openLandscape(next); }
    }
  };
  window.prevProject = function(){
    if(!ptCurrent && !lsCurrent) return;
    stopCurrentVideo();
    var currentProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
    var idx = -1;
    for(var i=0;i<current.length;i++){ if(current[i].id === currentProject.id){ idx=i; break; }}
    if(idx === -1){ for(var i=0;i<PROJECTS.length;i++){ if(PROJECTS[i].id === currentProject.id){ idx=i; break; }} }
    var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
    var prev = navList[(idx-1+navList.length)%navList.length];
    var isLandscapePrev = (prev.aspect === 'landscape' || prev.aspect === '16:9');
    var isCurrentPortraitModal = !!ptCurrent;
    if(isCurrentPortraitModal && isLandscapePrev){
      _closingViaPopstate = true;
      closePortrait();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      _lsModalHistoryPushed = true;
      setTimeout(function(){ openLandscape(prev); }, 100);
      return;
    }
    if(!isCurrentPortraitModal && !isLandscapePrev){
      _closingViaPopstate = true;
      closeLandscape();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      _ptModalHistoryPushed = true;
      setTimeout(function(){ openPortrait(prev); }, 100);
      return;
    }
    if(isCurrentPortraitModal){
      var card = document.querySelector('.pt-modal-card');
      if(card){
        card.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        card.style.transform = 'translateY(30px)';
        card.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function(){
          openPortrait(prev);
          card.style.transition = 'none';
          card.style.transform = 'translateY(-30px)';
          card.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(function(){
            card.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            card.style.transform = '';
            card.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openPortrait(prev); }
    } else {
      var lsCard = document.querySelector('.ls-modal-card');
      if(lsCard){
        lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(-30px)';
        lsCard.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function(){
          openLandscape(prev);
          lsCard.style.transition = 'none';
          lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(30px)';
          lsCard.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(function(){
            lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            lsCard.style.transform = '';
            lsCard.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openLandscape(prev); }
    }
  };

  function closePortrait() {
    document.body.classList.remove('video-playing');
    // Destroy HLS instance
    if(window._hlsInstance) { window._hlsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsInstance = null; }
    // Destroy progress bar
    if(window._ptProgressBar) { window._ptProgressBar.destroy(); window._ptProgressBar = null; }
    // Clear buffer monitor
    if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }
    // Stop video
    var video = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
    if(video) { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); video.style.display = 'none'; }
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('ptPlayBtn');
    if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
    var muteBtn = document.getElementById('ptMuteBtn');
    if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';
    var loader = document.getElementById('ptLoader');
    if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';

    var m = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    if(m){ m.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
    closeShareSheet();
    stopParticles();
    ptCurrent = null;
    // If closed via UI (not back button), consume the history entry
    var hadHistory = _ptModalHistoryPushed;
    _ptModalHistoryPushed = false;
    if(hadHistory && !_closingViaPopstate){ history.back(); }
  }
  // Expose to window for onclick handlers
  window.closePortrait = closePortrait;

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // LANDSCAPE MODAL — OPEN / CLOSE / CONTROLS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  function openLandscape(p) {
    document.body.classList.add('video-playing');
    lsCurrent = p;
    ptViews[p.id] = (ptViews[p.id] || 0) + 1;
    ptSaveViews();

    var el = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
    var bg = el('lsCardBg');
    if(p.thumb && bg) { bg.style.background = 'url(' + p.thumb + ') center/cover no-repeat'; }
    else if(bg) { bg.style.background = p.clr; }

    var catLabel = (p.cat||'').replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase();
    var c = el('lsCat'); if(c) c.textContent = catLabel + ' PROJECT';
    var t = el('lsTitle'); if(t) t.textContent = p.name;
    var cl = el('lsClient'); if(cl) cl.textContent = p.client;
    var d = el('lsDesc'); if(d) d.textContent = p.desc;

    var vc = el('lsViewsCount');
    if(vc) vc.textContent = formatViews(getViewCount(p.id)) + ' views';

    var counter = el('lsCounter');
    if(counter) {
      var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
      var idx = -1;
      for(var i=0;i<navList.length;i++){ if(navList[i].id === p.id){ idx=i; break; }}
      counter.innerHTML = '<span>' + String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span> / ' + String(navList.length).padStart(2,'0');
    }

    var meta = el('lsMeta');
    if(meta){
      var metaHTML = '';
      if(p.duration) metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#9201;</span> '+p.duration+'</span>';
      metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#127916;</span> 100% AI</span>';
      metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#128250;</span> 16:9 Widescreen</span>';
      meta.innerHTML = metaHTML;
    }

    var desc = el('lsDesc');
    var descToggle = el('lsDescToggle');
    if(desc) desc.classList.remove('open');
    if(descToggle) descToggle.classList.remove('open');

    // Update like/comment counts for landscape action bar
    lsUpdateLike(p.id);
    lsUpdateComment(p.id);

    // ── VIDEO PLAYER (Bunny Stream via HLS.js) — IMPROVED BUFFERING ──
    var video = el('lsVideo');
    var playBtn = el('lsPlayBtn');
    var muteBtn = el('lsMuteBtn');

    if(window._hlsLsInstance) { window._hlsLsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsLsInstance = null; }
    if(window._lsProgressBar) { window._lsProgressBar.destroy(); window._lsProgressBar = null; }
    if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }

    if(video) {
      video.onwaiting = null;
      video.onstalled = null;
      video.onplaying = null;
      video.ontimeupdate = null;
      video.pause();
      video.removeAttribute('src');
      video.load();
      video.style.display = 'none';
      var loader = el('lsLoader');
      if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
      if(playBtn) { playBtn.style.display = ''; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;'; }
      if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';

      var hasVideo = p.hls || p.mp4;
      if(hasVideo) {
        video.style.display = 'block';
        video.muted = true;
        video.loop = true;

        // Initialize progress bar for this video
        window._lsProgressBar = initProgressBar(video, 'lsProgressWrap', 'lsBufferBar', 'lsPlayBar', 'lsThumb', 'lsTimeDisplay');
        if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.reset();

        video.onwaiting = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
          if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
          if(window._lsBufferMonitor) clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor);
          window._lsBufferMonitor = setInterval(function(){
            var lead = getBufferLead(video);
            if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_RESUME){
              clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor);
              window._lsBufferMonitor = null;
              video.play().then(function(){
                if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              }).catch(function(){});
            }
          }, 300);
        };
        video.onplaying = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
          if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
          if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
          if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
          if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }
        };

        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
        if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';

        if(p.hls && Hls.isSupported()) {
          var hls = new Hls({
            startLevel: -1, capLevelToPlayerSize: true,
            maxBufferLength: 15, maxMaxBufferLength: 30,
            maxBufferSize: 10*1000*1000, maxBufferHole: 0.3,
            backBufferLength: 30, lowLatencyMode: false,
            abrEwmaDefaultEstimate: 1000000,
            abrBandWidthFactor: 0.95, abrBandWidthUpFactor: 0.7,
            enableWorker: true,
            fragLoadingTimeOut: 20000, fragLoadingMaxRetry: 6,
            fragLoadingRetryDelay: 1000,
            levelLoadingTimeOut: 15000, startFragPrefetch: true,
            testBandwidth: true,
            stretchShortVideoTrack: true,
            nudgeOffset: 0.2,
            nudgeMaxRetry: 5
          });
          hls.loadSource(p.hls);
          hls.attachMedia(video);
          hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, function(){
            // Let HLS.js ABR auto-select best quality
            var lsStartCheck = setInterval(function(){
              var lead = getBufferLead(video);
              if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_START){
                clearInterval(lsStartCheck);
                video.play().then(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
                  if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
                  if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
                }).catch(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
                });
              }
            }, 300);
          });
          hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, function(event, data){
            if(data.fatal){
              if(data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.NETWORK_ERROR) hls.startLoad();
              else if(data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR) hls.recoverMediaError();
              else if(p.mp4){ hls.destroy(); video.src = p.mp4; video.load(); video.play().catch(function(){}); }
            }
          });
          window._hlsLsInstance = hls;
        }
        else if(p.hls && video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
          video.src = p.hls; video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn){ muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){ if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = ''; });
          }, 500);
        }
        else if(p.mp4) {
          video.src = p.mp4; video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn){ muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){ if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = ''; });
          }, 500);
        }
      } else {
        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
        if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.hide();
      }
    }

    var m = el('lsModal');
    var _lsWasAlreadyOpen = m && m.classList.contains('open');
    if(m){ m.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
    if(!_lsWasAlreadyOpen && !_lsModalHistoryPushed){
      history.pushState({ modal: 'landscape' }, '', _bdzHashUrl('bdz-player'));
      _lsModalHistoryPushed = true;
    }
  }

  function closeLandscape() {
    document.body.classList.remove('video-playing');
    if(window._hlsLsInstance) { window._hlsLsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsLsInstance = null; }
    if(window._lsProgressBar) { window._lsProgressBar.destroy(); window._lsProgressBar = null; }
    if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }
    var video = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
    if(video) { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); video.style.display = 'none'; }
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('lsPlayBtn');
    if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
    var muteBtn = document.getElementById('lsMuteBtn');
    if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';
    var loader = document.getElementById('lsLoader');
    if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
    var m = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    if(m){ m.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
    var hadHistory = _lsModalHistoryPushed;
    _lsModalHistoryPushed = false;
    if(hadHistory && !_closingViaPopstate){ history.back(); }
    lsCurrent = null;
  }
  window.closeLandscape = closeLandscape;
  window.openLandscape = openLandscape;

  window.toggleLsMute = function() {
    var video = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
    var btn = document.getElementById('lsMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('lsMuteSvg');
    var hint = document.getElementById('lsMuteHint');
    if(!video || !btn || !svg) return;
    video.muted = !video.muted;
    if(video.muted){
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
      btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    } else {
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"/><path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"/>';
      btn.classList.add('unmuted');
      if(hint) hint.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };
  window._lsResetMuteIcon = function(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('lsMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('lsMuteSvg');
    if(btn) btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    if(svg) svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
  };
  window.toggleLsDesc = function(){
    var desc = document.getElementById('lsDesc');
    var toggle = document.getElementById('lsDescToggle');
    if(desc) desc.classList.toggle('open');
    if(toggle) toggle.classList.toggle('open');
  };

  // Landscape modal — tap to play/pause
  var lsVideoArea = document.getElementById('lsVideoArea');
  if(lsVideoArea) {
    lsVideoArea.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var video = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
      var playBtn = document.getElementById('lsPlayBtn');
      var loader = document.getElementById('lsLoader');
      if(video && video.src && video.src !== window.location.href) {
        if(video.paused) {
          video.play().then(function(){ if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none'; if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; }).catch(function(){});
        } else {
          video.pause(); if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Landscape modal — close handlers
  var lsCloseEl = document.getElementById('lsClose');
  if(lsCloseEl) lsCloseEl.addEventListener('click', closeLandscape);
  var lsBgEl = document.getElementById('lsModal');
  if(lsBgEl) lsBgEl.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===this) closeLandscape(); });

  // Landscape modal — swipe left/right OR up/down for next/prev
  var lsTouchStartX = 0;
  var lsTouchStartY = 0;
  var lsModalSwipe = document.getElementById('lsModal');
  if(lsModalSwipe) {
    lsModalSwipe.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      lsTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      lsTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    }, {passive: true});
    lsModalSwipe.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      var dx = lsTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      var dy = lsTouchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
      var absDx = Math.abs(dx);
      var absDy = Math.abs(dy);
      // Require minimum 50px swipe in dominant direction
      if(absDx > 50 && absDx > absDy) {
        // Horizontal swipe
        if(dx > 0) nextProject(); // Swipe left = next
        else prevProject(); // Swipe right = prev
      } else if(absDy > 50 && absDy > absDx) {
        // Vertical swipe
        if(dy > 0) nextProject(); // Swipe up = next
        else prevProject(); // Swipe down = prev
      }
    }, {passive: true});
  }

  // Back button closes modal instead of leaving the page
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function(e) {
    _closingViaPopstate = true;
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    if(lb && lb.classList.contains('open')) {
      closeReviewLightbox();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      return;
    }
    var lsM = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    if(lsM && lsM.classList.contains('open')) {
      closeLandscape();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      return;
    }
    var m = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    if(m && m.classList.contains('open')) {
      closePortrait();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      return;
    }
    _closingViaPopstate = false;
  });

  // Chrome Android fallback: hashchange fires when back button removes #bdz-player/#bdz-review
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function() {
    var h = window.location.hash;
    if(h === '#bdz-player' || h === '#bdz-review') return;
    _closingViaPopstate = true;
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    if(lb && lb.classList.contains('open')) { closeReviewLightbox(); _closingViaPopstate = false; return; }
    var lsM = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    if(lsM && lsM.classList.contains('open')) { closeLandscape(); _closingViaPopstate = false; return; }
    var m = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    if(m && m.classList.contains('open')) { closePortrait(); _closingViaPopstate = false; return; }
    _closingViaPopstate = false;
  });

  // Mute / Unmute toggle
  window.toggleMute = function() {
    var video = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
    var btn = document.getElementById('ptMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('ptMuteSvg');
    var hint = document.getElementById('ptMuteHint');
    if(!video || !btn || !svg) return;
    video.muted = !video.muted;
    if(video.muted){
      // Muted icon — speaker with X
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
      btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    } else {
      // Unmuted icon — speaker with sound waves
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"/><path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"/>';
      btn.classList.add('unmuted');
      // Kill the hint once sound is on
      if(hint) hint.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  // Helper: reset mute button to "muted" visual state (used when a new video auto-plays muted)
  window._ptResetMuteIcon = function(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('ptMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('ptMuteSvg');
    if(btn) btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    if(svg) svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
  };

  // Description toggle
  window.toggleDesc = function() {
    var desc = document.getElementById('ptDesc');
    var toggle = document.getElementById('ptDescToggle');
    if(desc) desc.classList.toggle('open');
    if(toggle) toggle.classList.toggle('open');
  };

  // LIKE with heart explosion animation
  function toggleLike() {
    var activeProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
    if(!activeProject) return;
    var id = activeProject.id;
    var wasLiked = !!ptLikes[id];
    ptLikes[id] = !ptLikes[id];
    ptSaveLikes();
    ptUpdateLike(id);
    lsUpdateLike(id);
    
    var btn = document.getElementById('ptLikeBtn') || document.getElementById('lsLikeBtn');
    if(btn){
      btn.style.transform = 'scale(1.35)';
      setTimeout(function(){ btn.style.transform=''; }, 300);
    }
    
    // Heart particle burst on like
    if(!wasLiked) {
      spawnHeartParticles();
    }
  }
  
  function spawnHeartParticles() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('ptLikeIco');
    if(!btn) return;
    var rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    var cx = rect.left + rect.width/2;
    var cy = rect.top + rect.height/2;
    var hearts = ['\u2764\uFE0F','\uD83D\uDC9B','\uD83E\uDDE1','\uD83D\uDC96','\u2728'];
    for(var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      var h = document.createElement('div');
      h.className = 'pt-heart-particle';
      h.textContent = hearts[Math.floor(Math.random()*hearts.length)];
      h.style.left = cx + 'px';
      h.style.top = cy + 'px';
      h.style.setProperty('--tx', (Math.random()-0.5)*80 + 'px');
      h.style.setProperty('--ty', -(Math.random()*60 + 20) + 'px');
      h.style.animationDuration = (0.6 + Math.random()*0.5) + 's';
      document.body.appendChild(h);
      (function(el){ setTimeout(function(){ if(el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el); }, 1200); })(h);
    }
  }

  // Double-tap to like, single tap to play/pause video
  var ptLastTap = 0;
  var ptTapTimer = null;
  var ptPlayArea = document.getElementById('ptPlayArea');
  if(ptPlayArea) {
    ptPlayArea.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var now = Date.now();
      if(now - ptLastTap < 400) {
        // Double tap — like
        clearTimeout(ptTapTimer);
        if(ptCurrent && !ptLikes[ptCurrent.id]) {
          toggleLike();
        }
        var heart = document.createElement('div');
        heart.className = 'pt-double-tap-heart';
        heart.textContent = '\u2764\uFE0F';
        heart.style.left = (e.clientX - 40) + 'px';
        heart.style.top = (e.clientY - 40) + 'px';
        document.body.appendChild(heart);
        setTimeout(function(){ if(heart.parentNode) heart.parentNode.removeChild(heart); }, 900);
      } else {
        // Single tap — toggle video play/pause (DO NOT touch mute state)
        ptTapTimer = setTimeout(function(){
          var video = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
          var playBtn = document.getElementById('ptPlayBtn');
          var loader = document.getElementById('ptLoader');
          if(video && video.src && video.src !== window.location.href) {
            if(video.paused) {
              video.play().then(function(){
                if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
                if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              }).catch(function(){});
            } else {
              video.pause();
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
            }
          }
        }, 250);
      }
      ptLastTap = now;
    });
  }

  function ptUpdateLike(id) {
    var btn = document.getElementById('ptLikeBtn');
    var ico = document.getElementById('ptLikeIco');
    var cnt = document.getElementById('ptLikeCount');
    var liked = !!ptLikes[id];
    if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('liked', liked);
    // Keep the SVG heart — CSS '.liked' state controls fill/stroke color
    if(ico) {
      ico.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="' + (liked ? '#D60000' : 'none') + '" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20.84 4.61a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 0L12 5.67l-1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.78 7.78l1.06 1.06L12 21.23l7.78-7.78 1.06-1.06a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.78z"/></svg>';
    }
    var base = {1:234,2:189,3:312,4:156,5:278,6:143,7:205,8:167,9:221};
    if(cnt) cnt.textContent = (base[id]||150) + (liked?1:0);
  }

  function showCommentPrompt() {
    ptShowToast('&#128172; Taking you to WhatsApp...', 1500);
    setTimeout(function(){
      var activeProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
      var msg = activeProject ? encodeURIComponent('Hi! I love the "' + activeProject.name + '" project on your portfolio. ') : '';

  function openShareSheet() {
    var activeProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
    if(!activeProject) return;
    
    var projectURL = getProjectShareURL(activeProject);
    var shareText = getProjectShareText(activeProject);
    
    // PRIORITIZE native share on mobile — trigger immediately
    if(navigator.share) {
      navigator.share({
        title: 'BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio',
        text: shareText,
        url: projectURL
      }).catch(function(err){
        // User cancelled or native share failed — fall back to custom sheet
        if(err.name !== 'AbortError') {
          showCustomShareSheet();
        }
      });
      return;
    }
    
    // Desktop/unsupported — show custom share sheet
    showCustomShareSheet();
  }
  
  function showCustomShareSheet() {
    // Share preview always shows the BRAND — the link points to the studio homepage
    var pn = document.getElementById('sharePreviewName');
    if(pn) pn.textContent = 'BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio';
    var pc = document.getElementById('sharePreviewColor');
    if(pc) pc.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg,#EFB20C,#7a5c08)';
    var pu = document.getElementById('sharePreviewUrl');
    if(pu) pu.textContent = SITE_URL.replace('https://','');
    var st = document.getElementById('shareSubtitle');
    if(st) st.textContent = 'Share the studio with your network';
    // Show native share button on supported devices
    var nativeBtn = document.getElementById('shareNativeBtn');
    if(nativeBtn) nativeBtn.style.display = navigator.share ? 'flex' : 'none';
    
    var s = document.getElementById('shareSheet');
    if(s) s.classList.add('open');
  }

  function closeShareSheet() {
    var s = document.getElementById('shareSheet');
    if(s) s.classList.remove('open');
  }

  function doShare(platform) {
    var activeProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
    if(!activeProject) { closeShareSheet(); return; }
    
    var projectURL = getProjectShareURL(activeProject);
    var shareText = getProjectShareText(activeProject);
    var url = encodeURIComponent(projectURL);
    var txt = encodeURIComponent(shareText);
    var title = encodeURIComponent('BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio');
    
    closeShareSheet();
    
    // Native share API
    if(platform === 'native' && navigator.share) {
      navigator.share({
        title: 'BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio',
        text: shareText,
        url: projectURL
      }).catch(function(){});
      return;
    }
    
    // Copy link
    if(platform === 'copy') {
      var copyText = shareText + '\n' + projectURL;
      try {
        if(navigator.clipboard){ navigator.clipboard.writeText(copyText); }
        else { var ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=copyText;document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();document.execCommand('copy');document.body.removeChild(ta); }
      } catch(e){}
      ptShowToast('&#10003; Link copied! Paste it anywhere.', 2500);
      return;
    }
    
    var links = {
      whatsapp: 'https://wa.me/?text=' + txt + '%20' + url,
      facebook: 'https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=' + url + '&quote=' + txt,
      twitter: 'https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=' + txt + '&url=' + url,
      telegram: 'https://t.me/share/url?url=' + url + '&text=' + txt,
      linkedin: 'https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=' + url,
      instagram: 'https://www.instagram.com/',
      email: 'mailto:?subject=' + title + '&body=' + txt + '%0A%0A' + url
    };
    
    if(platform === 'instagram') {
      // Instagram doesn't support direct URL sharing, copy link first
      var copyText2 = shareText + '\n' + projectURL;
      try {
        if(navigator.clipboard){ navigator.clipboard.writeText(copyText2); }
        else { var ta2=document.createElement('textarea');ta2.value=copyText2;document.body.appendChild(ta2);ta2.select();document.execCommand('copy');document.body.removeChild(ta2); }
      } catch(e2){}
      ptShowToast('&#128247; Link copied! Opening Instagram...', 2500);
      setTimeout(function(){ window.open('https://www.instagram.com/', '_blank'); }, 1200);
      return;
    }
    
    var link = links[platform];
    if(link) window.open(link, '_blank');
  }

  function ptShowToast(msg, dur) {
    var t = document.getElementById('copyToast');
    var tx = document.getElementById('copyToastTxt');
    if(tx) tx.innerHTML = msg;
    if(t){ t.classList.add('show'); setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('show'); }, dur||2000); }
  }

  // Touch swipe for next/prev on mobile
  var ptTouchStartY = 0;
  var ptModalEl = document.getElementById('ptModal');
  if(ptModalEl) {
    ptModalEl.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      ptTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    }, {passive: true});
    ptModalEl.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      var dy = ptTouchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
      if(Math.abs(dy) > 60) {
        if(dy > 0) nextProject(); // Swipe up = next
        else prevProject(); // Swipe down = prev
      }
    }, {passive: true});
  }

  // Keyboard navigation
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    var ptModal = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    var lsModal = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    var ptOpen = ptModal && ptModal.classList.contains('open');
    var lsOpen = lsModal && lsModal.classList.contains('open');
    if(!ptOpen && !lsOpen) return;
    if(e.key === 'Escape') { if(ptOpen) closePortrait(); if(lsOpen) closeLandscape(); }
    if(e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); nextProject(); }
    if(e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); prevProject(); }
    if(e.key === 'l' || e.key === 'L') toggleLike();
    if(e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S') openShareSheet();
  });

  window.toggleDNA = function(){
    var toggle = document.getElementById('dnaToggle');

    if(!toggle || !content) return;
    var isOpen = toggle.classList.contains('open');
    toggle.classList.toggle('open');

    // Stagger reveal beliefs
    if(!isOpen){
      var beliefs = content.querySelectorAll('.dna-belief');

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // ABOUT — ANIMATED STAT COUNTERS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  var aboutStatsAnimated = false;
  function animateAboutStats(){
    if(aboutStatsAnimated) return;
    aboutStatsAnimated = true;
    document.querySelectorAll('#aboutStatsRow [data-about-target]').forEach(function(el){
      var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-about-target'));
      var suffix = el.getAttribute('data-about-suffix') || '';
      var current = 0;
      var duration = 1800;
      var steps = 60;
      var step = target / steps;
      var interval = duration / steps;
      var timer = setInterval(function(){
        current += step;
        if(current >= target){ el.textContent = target + suffix; clearInterval(timer); }
        else el.textContent = Math.floor(current) + suffix;
      }, interval);
    });
  }
  var aboutStatsObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting) animateAboutStats(); });
  },{threshold:0.3});
  var aboutStatsEl = document.getElementById('aboutStatsRow');
  if(aboutStatsEl) aboutStatsObs.observe(aboutStatsEl);

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // ABOUT — SELF-DRAWING GOLD DIVIDERS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  var dividerObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('drawn');
    });
  },{threshold:0.5});
  document.querySelectorAll('.about-divider').forEach(function(d){ dividerObs.observe(d); });

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // ABOUT — CINEMATIC CLOSING REVEAL
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  var closingObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('reveal');
    });
  },{threshold:0.3});
  var closingText = document.getElementById('aboutClosingText');
  if(closingText) closingObs.observe(closingText);

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // ABOUT — AMBIENT PARTICLE CANVAS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  var aboutParticleAnim = null;
  function startAboutParticles(){
    var canvas = document.getElementById('aboutParticlesCanvas');
    if(!canvas) return;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize(){ canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    var particles = [];
    for(var i = 0; i < 30; i++){
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15,
        vy: -Math.random() * 0.3 - 0.05,
        size: Math.random() * 1.8 + 0.3,
        alpha: Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05,
        life: Math.random() * 300 + 150
      });
    }
    function animate(){
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(function(p){
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.life--;
        if(p.life <= 0 || p.y < -10){
          p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
          p.y = canvas.height + 10;
          p.life = Math.random() * 300 + 150;
          p.alpha = Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05;
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#EFB20C';
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * (p.life > 40 ? 1 : p.life / 40);
        ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      aboutParticleAnim = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
  }
  function stopAboutParticles(){
    if(aboutParticleAnim){ cancelAnimationFrame(aboutParticleAnim); aboutParticleAnim = null; }
    var canvas = document.getElementById('aboutParticlesCanvas');
    if(canvas){ var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); }
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // CONTACT PAGE — CINEMATIC ANIMATIONS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  var ctParticleAnim = null;

  // Contact section particle canvas
  function startContactParticles() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('ctParticles');
    if(!canvas) return;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    function resize() {
      canvas.width = canvas.parentElement.offsetWidth;
      canvas.height = canvas.parentElement.offsetHeight;
    }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    var particles = [];
    for(var i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
        vy: -Math.random() * 0.3 - 0.05,
        size: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
        alpha: Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05,
        life: Math.random() * 300 + 150
      });
    }
    function animate() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(function(p) {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.life--;
        if(p.life <= 0 || p.y < -10 || p.x < -10 || p.x > canvas.width + 10) {
          p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
          p.y = canvas.height + 10;
          p.life = Math.random() * 300 + 150;
          p.alpha = Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05;
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#EFB20C';
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * (p.life > 40 ? 1 : p.life / 40);
        ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctParticleAnim = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
  }

  function stopContactParticles() {
    if(ctParticleAnim) { cancelAnimationFrame(ctParticleAnim); ctParticleAnim = null; }
    var canvas = document.getElementById('ctParticles');
    if(canvas) { var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); }
  }

  // Progress bar animation for urgency section
  var ctBarAnimated = false;
  function animateContactBar() {
    if(ctBarAnimated) return;
    ctBarAnimated = true;
    var bar = document.getElementById('ctProgressBar');
    var filled = document.getElementById('ctSlotsFilled');
    if(bar) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        bar.style.width = '73.3%'; // 11 out of 15
      }, 300);
    }
    if(filled) {
      var current = 0;
      var target = 11;
      var timer = setInterval(function() {
        current++;
        if(current >= target) { filled.textContent = target; clearInterval(timer); }
        else filled.textContent = current;
      }, 120);
    }
  }

  // Observe the urgency section for progress animation
  var ctBarObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting) animateContactBar(); });
  },{threshold:0.3});
  var ctUrgency = document.querySelector('.ct-urgency');
  if(ctUrgency) ctBarObs.observe(ctUrgency);

  // Start/stop particles based on active page (both About + Contact)
  var origShowPage = window.showPage;
  window.showPage = function(name){
    origShowPage(name);
    if(name === 'about'){
      startAboutParticles();
      // Re-observe about dividers
      document.querySelectorAll('.about-divider').forEach(function(d){ dividerObs.observe(d); });
      // Re-observe closing
      if(closingText) closingObs.observe(closingText);
      // Re-observe about stats
      aboutStatsAnimated = false;
      if(aboutStatsEl) aboutStatsObs.observe(aboutStatsEl);
    } else {
      stopAboutParticles();
    }
    if(name === 'contact'){
      startContactParticles();
      // Reset bar animation so it plays each time
      ctBarAnimated = false;
      var bar = document.getElementById('ctProgressBar');
      if(bar) bar.style.width = '0%';
      var filled = document.getElementById('ctSlotsFilled');
      if(filled) filled.textContent = '0';
      setTimeout(function() {
        var bar = document.getElementById('ctProgressBar');
        if(bar) {
          bar.style.transition = 'width 2s ease';
          bar.style.width = '68%';
        }
        var filled = document.getElementById('ctSlotsFilled');
        if(filled) {
          var count = 0;
          var timer = setInterval(function() {
            count++;
            filled.textContent = count;
            if(count >= 14) clearInterval(timer);
          }, 120);
        }
      }, 400);
    }
  }

<script>
(function(){
  if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
    window.addEventListener('load', function(){
      navigator.serviceWorker.register('service-worker.js').catch(function(err){
        console.warn('[PWA] Service worker registration failed:', err);
      });
    });
  }

  var deferredPrompt = null;
  var DISMISS_KEY = 'bdzInstallDismissed';
  var DISMISS_DAYS = 14; // re-offer after this many days
  var sessionDismissed = false; // in-memory fallback if storage is blocked

  function isDismissed(){
    if(sessionDismissed) return true;
    try{
      var v = window.localStorage.getItem(DISMISS_KEY);
      if(!v) return false;
      var until = parseInt(v, 10);
      if(isNaN(until)) return false;
      if(Date.now() < until) return true;
      window.localStorage.removeItem(DISMISS_KEY);
      return false;
    }catch(e){ return false; }
  }

  function setDismissed(){
    sessionDismissed = true;
    try{
      var until = Date.now() + DISMISS_DAYS*24*60*60*1000;
      window.localStorage.setItem(DISMISS_KEY, String(until));
    }catch(e){ /* storage blocked - in-memory flag still applies */ }
  }

  function removeBanner(){
    var el = document.getElementById('bdzInstallBanner');
    if(el){ el.classList.remove('bdz-show'); setTimeout(function(){ if(el && el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el); }, 380); }
  }

  function showBanner(){
    if(isDismissed()) return;
    if(document.getElementById('bdzInstallBanner')) return;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.id = 'bdzInstallBanner';
    wrap.setAttribute('role','dialog');
    wrap.setAttribute('aria-label','Install BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio');

    var ico = document.createElement('div');
    ico.className = 'bdz-ico';
    ico.textContent = '\u2B07';

    var txt = document.createElement('div');
    txt.className = 'bdz-txt';
    var title = document.createElement('p');
    title.className = 'bdz-title';
    title.textContent = 'Install BiG-DreamzZ';
    var sub = document.createElement('p');
    sub.className = 'bdz-sub';
    sub.textContent = 'Add the studio to your home screen for the full cinematic experience \u2014 faster, full-screen, one tap away.';
    txt.appendChild(title);
    txt.appendChild(sub);

    var actions = document.createElement('div');
    actions.className = 'bdz-actions';
    var installBtn = document.createElement('button');
    installBtn.type = 'button';
    installBtn.className = 'bdz-install';
    installBtn.textContent = 'Install';
    var laterBtn = document.createElement('button');
    laterBtn.type = 'button';
    laterBtn.className = 'bdz-later';
    laterBtn.textContent = 'Not now';
    actions.appendChild(installBtn);
    actions.appendChild(laterBtn);

    var closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
    closeBtn.type = 'button';
    closeBtn.className = 'bdz-close';
    closeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label','Dismiss');
    closeBtn.textContent = '\u2715';

    wrap.appendChild(ico);
    wrap.appendChild(txt);
    wrap.appendChild(actions);
    wrap.appendChild(closeBtn);
    document.body.appendChild(wrap);
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){ wrap.classList.add('bdz-show'); });

    installBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if(!deferredPrompt){ removeBanner(); return; }
      deferredPrompt.prompt();
      deferredPrompt.userChoice.then(function(){
        deferredPrompt = null;
        removeBanner();
      });
    });
    function dismiss(){ setDismissed(); removeBanner(); }
    laterBtn.addEventListener('click', dismiss);
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', dismiss);
  }

  window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    deferredPrompt = e;
    showBanner();
  });
  window.addEventListener('appinstalled', function(){
    deferredPrompt = null;
    removeBanner();
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
  window.OneSignalDeferred = window.OneSignalDeferred || [];
  OneSignalDeferred.push(async function(OneSignal) {
    await OneSignal.init({
      appId: "3a6bdaaf-54fd-4b19-9142-190a5dee459f",
      serviceWorkerParam: { scope: "/push/onesignal/" },
      serviceWorkerPath: "push/onesignal/OneSignalSDKWorker.js",
      allowLocalhostAsSecureOrigin: true,
      autoResubscribe: true,
      notifyButton: { enable: false }
    });

    // Safety net: re-subscribe a device that allowed notifications but got opted out.
    try {
      if (OneSignal.Notifications.permission === true &&
          OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optedIn === false) {
        await OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optIn();
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Show the bell as already-subscribed if this device is.
    try {
      if (OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optedIn === true) bdSetBell(true);
    } catch (e) {}

    // Keep the bell in sync when the subscription changes.
    try {
      OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.addEventListener("change", function(ev){
        try { bdSetBell(!!(ev && ev.current && ev.current.optedIn)); } catch(e){}
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  });

  // Tapped the bell beside "Start a Similar Project"
  function bdSubscribe() {
    window.OneSignalDeferred = window.OneSignalDeferred || [];
    OneSignalDeferred.push(async function(OneSignal) {
      try {
        var already = false;
        try { already = (OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optedIn === true); } catch (e) {}
        if (already) {
          bdSetBell(true);
          bdToast("\uD83D\uDD14 You're already subscribed \u2014 we'll ping you with every new drop.");
          return; // never offer to unsubscribe
        }
        if (OneSignal.Notifications.permission === true) {
          await OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optIn();      // already allowed -> turn it on
          bdSetBell(true);
          bdToast("\uD83D\uDD14 You're in! You'll get our new films & drops.");
        } else {
          await OneSignal.Notifications.requestPermission();  // ask the phone
          if (OneSignal.Notifications.permission === true) {
            try { await OneSignal.User.PushSubscription.optIn(); } catch (e) {}
            bdSetBell(true);
            bdToast("\uD83D\uDD14 You're in! You'll get our new films & drops.");
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    });
  }

  // Bell ALWAYS stays a bell. Subscribed = wave rings appear (via a class), icon unchanged.
  function bdSetBell(on) {
    var bells = document.querySelectorAll('.bd-bell');
    for (var i = 0; i < bells.length; i++) {
      if (on) {
        bells[i].classList.add('bd-subscribed');
        bells[i].title = "You're subscribed - you'll get new drops";
      } else {
        bells[i].classList.remove('bd-subscribed');
        bells[i].title = "Get notified of new films & drops";
      }
    }
  }

  // Brief confirmation message near the bottom of the screen.
  function bdToast(msg) {
    var t = document.getElementById('bdToast');
    if (!t) {
      t = document.createElement('div');
      t.id = 'bdToast';
      document.body.appendChild(t);
    }
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(window.__bdToastTimer);
    window.__bdToastTimer = setTimeout(function () { t.classList.remove('show'); }, 2800);
  }
</script>

/* ── PORTRAIT VIDEO ON WIDE SCREENS (laptop / tablet) ──
   On phones (portrait, aspect < 9:16) NOTHING below applies — the video keeps filling
   the screen exactly as before. Everything inside @media (min-aspect-ratio:9/16) is
   laptop + wide-tablet ONLY.

   GOAL on wide screens: the portrait video sits as a clean centred column. The info
   (title / description / progress / CTA), the floating action rail (Like / Comment /
   Share / Next / Prev) and the mute (volume) button are ALL docked to that same centred
   column so they never collide, and the empty sides show a dark animated studio
   background instead of a blurry copy of the video. */
.pt-video-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background-position:center;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;filter:blur(48px) saturate(1.35) brightness(0.6);transform:scale(1.25);display:none;pointer-events:none;}

@media (min-aspect-ratio:9/16){
  /* Width of the centred video column. Video is height:100% with a 9:16 ratio,
     so its drawn width is 56.25vh (capped so it never exceeds the viewport).
     Defined on .pt-modal-bg so BOTH the card AND the sibling action rail can use it. */
  .pt-modal-bg{ --pt-col: min(56.25vh, 94vw); }

  /* ── Dark animated "studio" background instead of the blurry video copy ── */
  .pt-video-backdrop{
    display:block;
    filter:none !important;
    transform:none !important;
    background:none !important;
    background-color:#05070d !important;
    z-index:0;
  }
  /* Sparkles / starfield: layered radial dots that drift slowly (the gold
     particle canvas keeps running on top of this for extra life). */
  .pt-video-backdrop::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20%;pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(239,178,12,0.10), transparent 1.4px),
      radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), transparent 1.2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(239,178,12,0.07), transparent 1.6px);
    background-size:120px 120px, 200px 200px, 280px 280px;
    background-position:0 0, 40px 70px, 90px 30px;
    opacity:0.9;
    animation:ptStudioStars 60s linear infinite;
  }
  /* Soft moving glow so the dark sides feel like a lit studio, not flat black */
  .pt-video-backdrop::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 45% at 18% 22%, rgba(239,178,12,0.16), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 40% at 82% 78%, rgba(60,90,160,0.18), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 50%, rgba(13,27,42,0.55), transparent 70%);
    animation:ptStudioGlow 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes ptStudioStars{
    0%{background-position:0 0, 40px 70px, 90px 30px;}
    100%{background-position:0 -600px, 40px -730px, 90px -670px;}
  }
  @keyframes ptStudioGlow{
    0%{opacity:0.75;transform:scale(1);}
    100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.06);}
  }
  /* Keep the gradient vignette subtle so the studio background shows through the sides */
  .pt-modal-vig{background:radial-gradient(ellipse var(--pt-col) 100% at 50% 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.0) 60%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 100%), linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.85) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.0) 40%) !important;}

  /* ── Video: centred 9:16 column ── */
  #ptVideo{
    top:50% !important;left:50% !important;right:auto !important;bottom:auto !important;
    width:auto !important;height:100% !important;max-width:100% !important;
    aspect-ratio:9/16 !important;object-fit:contain !important;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%) !important;
    box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 120px rgba(239,178,12,0.08) !important;
    z-index:5 !important;
  }
  /* Play button stays centred on the video column */
  .pt-modal-play-area{z-index:6 !important;}

  /* ── INFO docked to the BOTTOM of the centred video column (not the whole screen) ── */
  .pt-modal-info{
    left:50% !important;right:auto !important;
    transform:translateX(-50%) !important;
    width:var(--pt-col) !important;
    max-width:var(--pt-col) !important;
    margin:0 !important;
    padding:0 18px 26px !important;
    box-sizing:border-box !important;
    text-align:left !important;
    z-index:12 !important;
  }
  .pt-modal-info .pt-modal-desc{max-width:100% !important;}

  /* ── MUTE / VOLUME button: docked to the TOP-RIGHT corner of the video column,
     pulled OFF the far edge so it can never touch the Like button again ── */
  .pt-mute-btn{
    top:16px !important;
    right:calc(50% - (var(--pt-col) / 2) + 12px) !important;
    z-index:26 !important;
  }
  .pt-mute-hint{
    top:78px !important;
    right:calc(50% - (var(--pt-col) / 2) + 12px) !important;
  }

  /* ── ACTION RAIL (Like / Comment / Share / Next / Prev): docked just OUTSIDE the
     right edge of the video column, vertically centred. Mute is at the top, the rail
     is centred lower down, so they have clear vertical separation — no collision. ── */
  .pt-side-actions{
    right:auto !important;
    left:calc(50% + (var(--pt-col) / 2) + 18px) !important;
    bottom:auto !important;
    top:50% !important;
    transform:translateY(-50%) !important;
    gap:22px !important;
    z-index:22 !important;
  }
  /* If the column is very wide and there isn't room beside it, gracefully overlay the
     rail just inside the right edge instead of pushing it off-screen. */
  @media (max-aspect-ratio:5/4){
    .pt-side-actions{
      left:auto !important;
      right:calc(50% - (var(--pt-col) / 2) + 12px) !important;
    }
  }

/* ─── LANDSCAPE MODAL — LAPTOP / TABLET WIDESCREEN OPTIMISATION ───
   Laptop + tablet ONLY (>=768px). Phones (mobile) are untouched — they keep the
   original scrolling stacked layout. Goals: the 16:9 video is properly sized and
   centred on screen, the empty area around it shows the SAME dark animated studio
   glow used by the portrait player (no thumbnail peeking behind), the title /
   description / "Start a Similar Project" are all visible WITHOUT scrolling, and the
   volume (mute) button is docked beside the action rail instead of far away at the
   top-right corner. */
@media(min-width:768px){
  /* Lock the modal to the viewport — no vertical scrolling needed on wide screens. */
  .ls-modal-bg{overflow:hidden;}
  .ls-modal-card{min-height:100vh;height:100vh;justify-content:center;}

  /* Replace the blurred project thumbnail with the dark animated studio backdrop. */
  .ls-card-bg{background:#05070d !important;}
  .ls-card-bg::after{
    content:"" !important;background:none !important;filter:none !important;
    opacity:1 !important;animation:none !important;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 18% 22%, rgba(239,178,12,0.16), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 82% 78%, rgba(60,90,160,0.18), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 50%, rgba(13,27,42,0.55), transparent 70%) !important;
  }
  /* Soft drifting glow layer so the empty sides feel like a lit studio, not flat black. */
  .ls-modal-card::before{
    content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(239,178,12,0.08), transparent 1.4px),
      radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), transparent 1.2px);
    background-size:120px 120px, 200px 200px;
    background-position:0 0, 40px 70px;
    opacity:0.7;animation:ptStudioStars 60s linear infinite;
  }

  /* Content fits the viewport as a centred column; everything visible without scroll. */
  .ls-modal-content{
    padding:64px 0 0;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
    width:100%;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;box-sizing:border-box;
  }
  /* Video sized to the screen: capped by both width and a height that leaves room for
     the action bar + info, so the title & CTA stay on-screen. object-fit:contain keeps
     the full 16:9 frame; uncovered area shows the studio glow behind it. */
  .ls-modal-video-area{
    width:auto !important;max-width:min(94vw,1100px) !important;

  // BUNNY STREAM CONFIG
  // ══════════════════════════════════
  var BUNNY_CDN = 'vz-bfdb6f21-38a.b-cdn.net';

  // Auto-generate thumbnail from Bunny video ID
  function autoThumb(videoId) {
    if(!videoId) return '';
    // If it's already a full thumbnail URL (Cloudinary or Bunny), use it directly
    if(videoId.indexOf('cloudinary') > -1) return videoId;
    if(videoId.indexOf('thumbnail.jpg') > -1) return videoId;
    // If it's a full Bunny URL, extract the GUID
    if(videoId.indexOf('http') === 0) {
      var match = videoId.match(/([a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12})/i);
      if(match) return 'https://' + BUNNY_CDN + '/' + match[1] + '/thumbnail.jpg';
      return '';
    }
    // Clean bare video ID
    var clean = videoId.replace(/[\s\/]+/g, '');
    if(!clean) return '';
    return 'https://' + BUNNY_CDN + '/' + clean + '/thumbnail.jpg';
  }

  // Construct Bunny HLS streaming URL from video ID
  function bunnyStreamUrl(videoId) {
    if(!videoId) return '';
    if(videoId.indexOf('playlist.m3u8') > -1) return videoId;
    var clean = videoId;
    if(videoId.indexOf('http') === 0) {
      var match = videoId.match(/([a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12})/i);
      if(match) clean = match[1]; else return videoId;
    }
    clean = clean.replace(/[\s\/]+/g, '');
    return 'https://' + BUNNY_CDN + '/' + clean + '/playlist.m3u8';
  }

  // Construct Bunny direct MP4 URL (fallback)
  function bunnyMp4Url(videoId) {
    if(!videoId) return '';
    if(videoId.indexOf('play_') > -1 || videoId.indexOf('.mp4') > -1) return videoId;
    var clean = videoId;
    if(videoId.indexOf('http') === 0) {
      var match = videoId.match(/([a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12})/i);
      if(match) clean = match[1]; else return videoId;
    }
    clean = clean.replace(/[\s\/]+/g, '');
    return 'https://' + BUNNY_CDN + '/' + clean + '/play_720p.mp4';
  }

  // ══════════════════════════════════
  // DYNAMIC TESTIMONIALS + REVIEW CAROUSELS
