  // ── SMOOTH AUTO-SCROLL ENGINE ──
  var _autoScrolls = {};

  function initSmoothAutoScroll(trackId, speed) {
    if (_autoScrolls[trackId]) cancelAnimationFrame(_autoScrolls[trackId].raf);
    var track = document.getElementById(trackId);
    if (!track) return;
    var state = { paused: false, raf: null, speed: speed || 0.5 };
    _autoScrolls[trackId] = state;

    // Duplicate content once for seamless loop
    var originalHTML = track.innerHTML;
    track.innerHTML = originalHTML + originalHTML;

    function step() {
      if (!state.paused && track.scrollWidth > track.clientWidth) {
        track.scrollLeft += state.speed;
        // When we've scrolled past the first set, jump back to start
        var halfWidth = track.scrollWidth / 2;
        if (track.scrollLeft >= halfWidth) {
          track.scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft - halfWidth;
        }
      }
      state.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    state.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);

    // Pause on touch
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', function() { state.paused = true; }, {passive:true});
    track.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
      setTimeout(function() { state.paused = false; }, 3000);
    }, {passive:true});
    // Pause on mouse hover (desktop)
    track.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { state.paused = true; });
    track.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { state.paused = false; });
  }

  // ── ARROW NAVIGATION (generic) ──
  // Content is duplicated (originalHTML + originalHTML) for the seamless auto-scroll,
  // so the real loop point is scrollWidth/2. We wrap scrollLeft around that boundary
  // BEFORE scrolling so clicking the arrows is endless in both directions — exactly
  // like the finger-swipe / auto-scroll loop on mobile.
  function _reelStep(trackId, dir) {
    var track = document.getElementById(trackId);
    if (!track) return;
    if (_autoScrolls[trackId]) _autoScrolls[trackId].paused = true;
    var step = Math.max(220, Math.round(track.clientWidth * 0.8));
    var half = track.scrollWidth / 2; // width of one original (un-duplicated) set
    if (half > 0) {
      if (dir > 0 && track.scrollLeft >= half) {
        // near the end of the second copy → jump back by one set, then continue right
        track.scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft - half;
      } else if (dir < 0 && track.scrollLeft <= 0) {
        // at the very start → jump forward by one set, then continue left
        track.scrollLeft = half;
      }
    }
    track.scrollBy({left: dir * step, behavior: 'smooth'});
    setTimeout(function() { if (_autoScrolls[trackId]) _autoScrolls[trackId].paused = false; }, 3000);
  }
  function scrollTrackLeft(trackId) { _reelStep(trackId, -1); }
  function scrollTrackRight(trackId) { _reelStep(trackId, 1); }
  window.scrollTrackLeft = scrollTrackLeft;
  window.scrollTrackRight = scrollTrackRight;

  // Keep old function names for Studio page arrows
  function scrollResultsLeft() { scrollTrackLeft('resultsScrollTrack'); }
  function scrollResultsRight() { scrollTrackRight('resultsScrollTrack'); }
  window.scrollResultsLeft = scrollResultsLeft;
  window.scrollResultsRight = scrollResultsRight;

  // ── BUILD REVIEW CARD HTML ──
  function buildReviewCardHTML(review) {
    var stars = '';
    var rating = review.rating || 5;
    for (var i = 0; i < rating; i++) stars += '\u2605';
    var src = review.screenshot_url || '';
    var name = review.name || '';
    var role = review.role || '';
    return '<div class="rsc-card" data-review-src="' + src.replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + '" data-review-name="' + name.replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + '" data-review-role="' + role.replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + '" data-review-rating="' + rating + '">' +
      '<img src="' + src + '" alt="Review by ' + name + '" loading="lazy">' +
      '<div class="rsc-card-overlay">' +
        '<div class="rsc-card-name">' + name + '</div>' +
        (role ? '<div class="rsc-card-role">' + role + '</div>' : '') +
        '<div class="rsc-card-stars">' + stars + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  // ── TAP DETECTION FOR REVIEW CARDS (mobile + desktop) ──
  // On mobile, overflow-x:auto containers suppress 'click' events.
  // We use touchstart/touchend with movement threshold to detect taps.
  function attachCardTapListeners(trackId) {
    var track = document.getElementById(trackId);
    if (!track) return;
    var cards = track.querySelectorAll('.rsc-card');
    cards.forEach(function(card, idx) {
      // Assign stagger index for CSS animations
      card.style.setProperty('--card-i', idx);

      // Mobile tap detection
      card.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
        this._tapX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        this._tapY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        this._tapTime = Date.now();
      }, {passive: true});

      card.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
        if (!this._tapX && this._tapX !== 0) return;
        var dx = Math.abs(e.changedTouches[0].clientX - this._tapX);
        var dy = Math.abs(e.changedTouches[0].clientY - this._tapY);
        var dt = Date.now() - this._tapTime;
        // If finger barely moved and tap was quick, it's a tap not a scroll
        if (dx < 12 && dy < 12 && dt < 400) {
          e.preventDefault();
          var src = this.getAttribute('data-review-src');
          var name = this.getAttribute('data-review-name');
          var role = this.getAttribute('data-review-role');
          var rating = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-review-rating')) || 5;
          if (src) openReviewLightbox(src, name || '', role || '', rating);
        }
        this._tapX = null;
      });

      // Desktop click fallback
      card.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var src = this.getAttribute('data-review-src');
        var name = this.getAttribute('data-review-name');
        var role = this.getAttribute('data-review-role');
        var rating = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-review-rating')) || 5;
        if (src) openReviewLightbox(src, name || '', role || '', rating);
      });
    });
  }

  // ── LOAD SCREENSHOT REVIEWS FROM SUPABASE ──
  function loadTestimonialsFromAPI() {
    sbFetch('/rest/v1/testimonials?select=*&published=eq.true&order=created_at.desc')
    .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      var section = document.getElementById('resultsSpeakSection');
      var track = document.getElementById('resultsScrollTrack');
      var countEl = document.getElementById('resultsReviewCount');
      if (!track || !section) return;
      if (!data || !Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
        section.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }
      var reviews = data.filter(function(t) { return t.screenshot_url; });
      if (reviews.length === 0) {
        section.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      section.style.display = '';
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = reviews.length;

      // Shuffle reviews so order is different each page load
      reviews = shuf(reviews);

      // Build cards HTML
      var html = '';
      reviews.forEach(function(t) { html += buildReviewCardHTML(t); });

      // Studio page carousel
      track.innerHTML = html;
      initSmoothAutoScroll('resultsScrollTrack', 0.5);
      attachCardTapListeners('resultsScrollTrack');

      // About page carousel (duplicate the same reviews)
      var aboutTrack = document.getElementById('aboutReviewTrack');
      var aboutSection = document.getElementById('aboutReviewsSection');
      if (aboutTrack && aboutSection) {
        aboutTrack.innerHTML = html;
        aboutSection.style.display = '';
        initSmoothAutoScroll('aboutReviewTrack', 0.4);
        attachCardTapListeners('aboutReviewTrack');
      }

      // Contact page carousel (screenshot reviews at conversion point)
      var ctTrack = document.getElementById('ctReviewTrack');
      var ctSection = document.getElementById('ctReviewsSection');
      if (ctTrack && ctSection) {
        ctTrack.innerHTML = html;
        ctSection.style.display = '';
        initSmoothAutoScroll('ctReviewTrack', 0.35);
        attachCardTapListeners('ctReviewTrack');
      }

      setTimeout(checkReveals, 100);
    })
    .catch(function(e) { console.log('Testimonials load failed:', e); });
  }

  // ── LOAD WRITTEN TESTIMONIALS INTO ABOUT PAGE SLIDER ──
  function loadWrittenTestimonials() {
    sbFetch('/rest/v1/testimonials?select=*&published=eq.true&order=created_at.desc')
    .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      var track = document.getElementById('testimonialSliderTrack');
      if (!track || !data || !Array.isArray(data)) return;
      var written = data.filter(function(t) { return t.quote && !t.screenshot_url; });
      if (written.length === 0) {
        // Shuffle hardcoded testimonials before auto-scroll
        shuffleDOMChildren(track);
        initSmoothAutoScroll('testimonialSliderTrack', 0.35);
        return;
      }
      var html = '';
      written.forEach(function(t) {
        var stars = '';
        var rating = t.rating || 5;
        for (var s = 0; s < rating; s++) stars += '\u2605';
        html += '<div class="tc"><span class="tc-q">\u201C</span>' +
          '<div class="tc-stars">' + stars + '</div>' +
          '<p class="tc-text">' + (t.quote || '') + '</p>' +
          '<div class="tc-name">' + (t.name || '') + '</div>' +
          (t.role ? '<div class="tc-role">' + t.role + '</div>' : '') +
        '</div>';
      });
      track.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
      // Shuffle ALL children (hardcoded + dynamic) so order differs each load
      shuffleDOMChildren(track);
      initSmoothAutoScroll('testimonialSliderTrack', 0.35);
    })
    .catch(function(e) {
      console.log('Written testimonials load failed:', e);
      // Shuffle hardcoded testimonials even on API failure
      var track = document.getElementById('testimonialSliderTrack');
      if (track) shuffleDOMChildren(track);
      initSmoothAutoScroll('testimonialSliderTrack', 0.35);
    });
  }

  // ── REVIEW LIGHTBOX — CINEMATIC UPGRADE ──
  var _currentReviewImgSrc = '';
  var _reviewList = []; // Array of {src, name, role, rating} for navigation
  var _currentReviewIndex = -1;
  var _lbSwipeStartX = 0;
  var _lbSwipeStartY = 0;
  var _lbSwipeStartTime = 0;
  var _lbIsClosing = false;

  // Collect all review data from visible cards for navigation
  function _collectReviewList() {
    _reviewList = [];
    // Try to find cards from whichever track is currently visible (check active page)
    var tracks = ['resultsScrollTrack', 'aboutReviewTrack', 'ctReviewTrack'];
    for (var t = 0; t < tracks.length; t++) {
      var track = document.getElementById(tracks[t]);
      if (track) {
        // Check if the track's parent page is active (visible)
        var parentPage = track.closest('.page');
        if (parentPage && !parentPage.classList.contains('active')) continue;
        var cards = track.querySelectorAll('.rsc-card');
        if (cards.length > 0) {
          cards.forEach(function(card) {
            _reviewList.push({
              src: card.getAttribute('data-review-src') || '',
              name: card.getAttribute('data-review-name') || '',
              role: card.getAttribute('data-review-role') || '',
              rating: parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-review-rating')) || 5
            });
          });
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    // Fallback: collect from all tracks
    if (_reviewList.length === 0) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.rsc-card').forEach(function(card) {
        var src = card.getAttribute('data-review-src') || '';
        // Avoid duplicates
        var isDup = _reviewList.some(function(r) { return r.src === src; });
        if (!isDup) {
          _reviewList.push({
            src: src,
            name: card.getAttribute('data-review-name') || '',
            role: card.getAttribute('data-review-role') || '',
            rating: parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-review-rating')) || 5
          });
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function _updateLightboxContent(src, name, role, rating) {
    var img = document.getElementById('reviewLightboxImg');
    var fallback = document.getElementById('reviewLbFallback');
    var nm = document.getElementById('reviewLightboxName');
    var rl = document.getElementById('reviewLightboxRole');
    var starsEl = document.getElementById('reviewLbStars');
    var counterEl = document.getElementById('reviewLbCounter');
    _currentReviewImgSrc = src || '';
    // Reset fallback state before loading new image
    if (fallback) fallback.style.display = 'none';
    if (img) {
      img.style.display = 'block';
      img.src = src || '';
    }
    if (nm) nm.textContent = name || '';
    if (rl) rl.textContent = role || '';
    // Stars
    if (starsEl) {
      var r = rating || 5;
      var starsHtml = '';
      for (var s = 0; s < r; s++) starsHtml += '\u2605';
      starsEl.innerHTML = starsHtml;
    }
    // Counter
    if (counterEl && _reviewList.length > 1) {
      counterEl.textContent = (_currentReviewIndex + 1) + ' / ' + _reviewList.length;
    } else if (counterEl) {
      counterEl.textContent = '';
    }
    // Hide/show nav arrows
    var prevBtn = document.getElementById('reviewLbPrev');
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById('reviewLbNext');
    if (_reviewList.length <= 1) {
      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.display = 'none';
      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.display = '';
      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.display = '';
    }
  }

  function openReviewLightbox(src, name, role, rating) {
    if (_lbIsClosing) return;
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    _collectReviewList();
    // Find current index
    _currentReviewIndex = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < _reviewList.length; i++) {
      if (_reviewList[i].src === src) { _currentReviewIndex = i; break; }
    }
    _updateLightboxContent(src, name, role, rating);
    var _lbWasOpen = lb && lb.classList.contains('open');
    if (lb) {
      lb.classList.remove('closing');
      lb.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    if(!_lbWasOpen && !_rlbHistoryPushed){
      history.pushState({ modal: 'reviewLightbox' }, '', _bdzHashUrl('bdz-review'));
      _rlbHistoryPushed = true;
    }
    // Swipe hint: only show first 3 times
    var hintCount = 0;
    try { hintCount = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('_lbHintCount') || '0'); } catch(e){}
    var hint = document.getElementById('reviewLbSwipeHint');
    if (hint && _reviewList.length > 1 && hintCount < 3) {
      hint.style.display = '';
      hint.style.animation = 'none';
      void hint.offsetWidth;
      hint.style.animation = '';
      try { localStorage.setItem('_lbHintCount', String(hintCount + 1)); } catch(e){}
    } else if (hint) {
      hint.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  function closeReviewLightbox() {
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    if (!lb || !lb.classList.contains('open') || _lbIsClosing) return;
    _lbIsClosing = true;
    lb.classList.add('closing');
    lb.classList.remove('open');
    var hadHistory = _rlbHistoryPushed;
    _rlbHistoryPushed = false;
    if(hadHistory && !_closingViaPopstate){ history.back(); }
    setTimeout(function() {
      lb.classList.remove('closing');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      _lbIsClosing = false;
    }, 500);
  }

  function navigateReview(dir) {
    if (_reviewList.length <= 1) return;
    var newIdx = _currentReviewIndex + dir;
    if (newIdx < 0) newIdx = _reviewList.length - 1;
    if (newIdx >= _reviewList.length) newIdx = 0;
    _currentReviewIndex = newIdx;
    var review = _reviewList[newIdx];
    // Slide animation
    var inner = document.getElementById('reviewLightboxInner');
    if (inner) {
      var slideDir = dir > 0 ? '-12px' : '12px';
      inner.style.transition = 'transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease';
      inner.style.transform = 'translateX(' + slideDir + ')';
      inner.style.opacity = '0.4';
      setTimeout(function() {
        _updateLightboxContent(review.src, review.name, review.role, review.rating);
        inner.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (dir > 0 ? '12px' : '-12px') + ')';
        setTimeout(function() {
          inner.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
          inner.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
          inner.style.opacity = '1';
          setTimeout(function() { inner.style.transition = ''; }, 350);
        }, 30);
      }, 200);
    } else {
      _updateLightboxContent(review.src, review.name, review.role, review.rating);
    }
  }
  window.navigateReview = navigateReview;

  // Swipe gestures on the lightbox
  (function() {
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    if (!lb) return;
    lb.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      if (e.target.closest('.review-lb-back') || e.target.closest('.review-lb-share') || e.target.closest('.review-lb-nav')) return;
      _lbSwipeStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      _lbSwipeStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      _lbSwipeStartTime = Date.now();
    }, {passive: true});
    lb.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      if (!_lbSwipeStartX && _lbSwipeStartX !== 0) return;
      var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - _lbSwipeStartX;
      var dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - _lbSwipeStartY;
      var dt = Date.now() - _lbSwipeStartTime;
      var absDx = Math.abs(dx);
      var absDy = Math.abs(dy);
      // Horizontal swipe for navigation
      if (absDx > 50 && absDx > absDy * 1.5 && dt < 500) {
        if (dx < 0) navigateReview(1);
        else navigateReview(-1);
      }
      // Vertical swipe down to close
      else if (dy > 80 && absDy > absDx * 1.5 && dt < 600) {
        closeReviewLightbox();
      }
      _lbSwipeStartX = 0;
    });
    // Close when clicking on the dark overlay (not the inner content)
    lb.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === lb || e.target.classList.contains('review-lb-grain') || e.target.classList.contains('review-lb-spotlight')) {
        closeReviewLightbox();
      }
    });
    // Keyboard navigation
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (!lb.classList.contains('open')) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') closeReviewLightbox();
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') navigateReview(-1);
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') navigateReview(1);
    });
  })();

  function shareReviewLightbox() {
    var siteUrl = window.location.origin || 'https://big-dreamzz-ai-studio.netlify.app';
    var shareTitle = 'BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio \u2014 Client Review';
    var shareText = 'See what clients say about BiG-DreamzZ AI Studio';
    var shareUrl = siteUrl;
    if (navigator.share) {
      navigator.share({ title: shareTitle, text: shareText, url: shareUrl })
        .catch(function() {
          if (shareUrl !== siteUrl) {
            navigator.share({ title: shareTitle, text: shareText, url: siteUrl }).catch(function(){});
          }
        });
    } else {
      var fallbackUrl = siteUrl;
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(fallbackUrl).then(function() {
          showReviewShareToast('Link copied!');
        }).catch(function() { showReviewShareToast('Could not copy link'); });
      } else {
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = fallbackUrl;
        ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0;';
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
        showReviewShareToast('Link copied!');
      }
    }
  }

  function showReviewShareToast(msg) {
    var existing = document.getElementById('reviewShareToast');
    if (existing) existing.remove();
    var t = document.createElement('div');
    t.id = 'reviewShareToast';
    t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:80px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:rgba(10,15,24,0.95);border:1px solid rgba(239,178,12,0.3);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 22px;z-index:9000;font-family:Orbitron,sans-serif;font-size:0.44rem;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:#EFB20C;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);';
    t.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function() { t.style.transition = 'opacity 0.4s'; t.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(function() { t.remove(); }, 400); }, 2200);
  }

    }

    card.innerHTML=

      '</div>';
    card.addEventListener("click",function(){ if(p.aspect==='landscape'||p.aspect==='16:9') openLandscape(p); else openPortrait(p); });

  }

  // ── GRID LAYOUT PATTERNS ──
  // MOBILE (unchanged): PP-L-PPPP-L — exactly as before, 8 slots.
  //   Layout slots: 0=portrait,1=portrait,2=landscape,3=portrait,4=portrait,5=portrait,6=portrait,7=landscape
  // DESKTOP/LAPTOP/TABLET: clean 4-portrait + 2-landscape repeating block (tiles a 4-column grid with NO gaps).
  //   One block = P P P P (full row of 4) then L L (two landscapes side-by-side filling the next row).
  //   Two blocks are rendered on desktop = 4 full rows, no awkward empty cells.
  var FEED_PATTERN_MOBILE  = ['p','p','L','p','p','p','p','L'];                 // 8 slots (mobile — DO NOT CHANGE)
  var FEED_PATTERN_DESKTOP = ['p','p','p','p','L','L','p','p','p','p','L','L'];  // 12 slots (laptop/tablet)

  // True when the laptop/tablet grid layout is active (matches the 4-column desktop CSS at >=1024px,
  // and the 3-column tablet CSS at 768–1023px). Mobile (<768px) keeps the original mobile pattern.
  function isDesktopGrid(){
    return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia
      ? window.matchMedia('(min-width:768px)').matches
      : false;
  }

  function renderFeed(){
    var feed=document.getElementById("homeFeed");
    if(!feed)return;
    feed.innerHTML="";
    var desktop = isDesktopGrid();
    var PATTERN = desktop ? FEED_PATTERN_DESKTOP : FEED_PATTERN_MOBILE;
    // Full shuffled pool — reshuffles every load/refresh (same logic as mobile).
    // L-slots: ANY video may appear here, including PORTRAIT videos (their thumbnail shows
    //   landscape-cropped, but clicking still opens/plays them as portrait).
    // P-slots: NEVER a landscape video.
    var shuffled = shuf(current.slice());
    var items = [];
    var used = {};
    for(var s = 0; s < PATTERN.length; s++){
      var slot = PATTERN[s];
      var picked = null;
      if(slot === 'L'){
        // L-slot: prefer an unused video; if all used, reuse from the pool (landscapes are few,
        // so portraits legitimately fill landscape frames and frames are never left empty).
        for(var j = 0; j < shuffled.length; j++){
          if(!used[shuffled[j].id]){ picked = shuffled[j]; break; }
        }
        if(!picked && desktop && shuffled.length){ picked = shuffled[s % shuffled.length]; }
      } else {
        // P-slot: any unused video EXCEPT landscape.
        for(var k = 0; k < shuffled.length; k++){
          if(!used[shuffled[k].id] && shuffled[k].aspect !== 'landscape' && shuffled[k].aspect !== '16:9'){
            picked = shuffled[k]; break;
          }
        }
        // Desktop only: if no unused portrait remains, reuse any portrait so the P-slot is never
        // empty/landscape. (Mobile keeps the original behaviour — slot is simply skipped.)
        if(!picked && desktop){
          for(var k2 = 0; k2 < shuffled.length; k2++){
            if(shuffled[k2].aspect !== 'landscape' && shuffled[k2].aspect !== '16:9'){ picked = shuffled[k2]; break; }
          }
        }
      }
      if(!picked) continue;
      used[picked.id] = true;
      items.push({ p: picked, slot: slot });
    }
    items.forEach(function(entry, i){
      var isLandscapeSlot = (entry.slot === 'L');
      var extraClass = isLandscapeSlot ? 'featured' : '';
      var card = makeCard(entry.p, "feed-card " + extraClass, "feed-name", "feed-cat", "feed-client");
      card.style.opacity = "0";
      card.style.transition = "opacity 0.65s ease " + (i * 0.07) + "s,transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)";
      feed.appendChild(card);
      setTimeout(function(){ card.style.opacity = "1"; }, 80 + i * 75);
    });
  }

  var wsAnimated = false;
  function animateWorkStats(){
    if(wsAnimated) return;
    wsAnimated = true;
    document.querySelectorAll('#workStatsStrip .ws-stat-num').forEach(function(el){
      var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count'));
      var suffix = el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
      var current = 0;
      var duration = 1500;
      var steps = 50;
      var step = target / steps;
      var interval = duration / steps;
      var timer = setInterval(function(){
        current += step;
        if(current >= target){ el.textContent = target + suffix; clearInterval(timer); }
        else el.textContent = Math.floor(current) + suffix;
      }, interval);
    });
  }
  var wsObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting) animateWorkStats(); });
  },{threshold:0.3});
  var wsStrip = document.getElementById('workStatsStrip');
  if(wsStrip) wsObs.observe(wsStrip);

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // WORK GRID — SPLIT INTO TWO HALVES
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  var activeF="all";
  var current=PROJECTS.slice();
  function shuf(a){var r=a.slice();for(var i=r.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));var t=r[i];r[i]=r[j];r[j]=t;}return r;}
  // Shuffle direct children of a DOM element in-place (Fisher-Yates)
  function shuffleDOMChildren(parent){
    if(!parent || parent.children.length < 2) return;
    var arr = Array.prototype.slice.call(parent.children);
    // Fisher-Yates on the array
    for(var i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      var tmp = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = tmp;
    }
    // Re-append in shuffled order (appendChild moves existing nodes)
    for(var k = 0; k < arr.length; k++){
      parent.appendChild(arr[k]);
    }
  }
  current=shuf(current);
  featuredProject = current[0]; // Now current is defined, set shuffled featured project

  // WORK GRID PATTERNS — same idea as the home feed.
  //   MOBILE (unchanged): PP-L-PPPP-L (8-slot repeat) — kept exactly as before.
  //   DESKTOP/LAPTOP/TABLET: clean 4-portrait + 2-landscape block (P P P P then L L) that tiles
  //     a 4-column grid with no gaps. Extra landscape frames are added on desktop and may be filled
  //     by portrait videos (thumbnail landscape-cropped, plays as portrait) since landscapes are few.
  var WORK_PATTERN_MOBILE  = ['p','p','L','p','p','p','p','L'];
  var WORK_PATTERN_DESKTOP = ['p','p','p','p','L','L'];

  function renderWork(){
    var gridTop=document.getElementById("workGridTop");
    var gridBot=document.getElementById("workGridBottom");
    if(!gridTop || !gridBot) return;
    gridTop.innerHTML="";
    gridBot.innerHTML="";
    var list=activeF==="all"?current:current.filter(function(p){return p.cat===activeF;});

    var desktop = isDesktopGrid();
    var WORK_PATTERN = desktop ? WORK_PATTERN_DESKTOP : WORK_PATTERN_MOBILE;

    var shuffled = shuf(list.slice());
    if(!shuffled.length){ return; }

    // reuse=true only on desktop, where extra frames may be re-filled by portraits so rows never gap.
    // On mobile, reuse=false reproduces the original behaviour exactly (no duplicates; slot skipped if none left).
    function pickPortrait(used, reuse){
      for(var k = 0; k < shuffled.length; k++){
        if(!used[shuffled[k].id] && shuffled[k].aspect !== 'landscape' && shuffled[k].aspect !== '16:9') return shuffled[k];
      }
      if(!reuse) return null;
      // desktop reuse: any portrait so a landscape/portrait frame is never empty
      for(var k2 = 0; k2 < shuffled.length; k2++){
        if(shuffled[k2].aspect !== 'landscape' && shuffled[k2].aspect !== '16:9') return shuffled[k2];
      }
      return null;
    }
    function pickAny(used, idx, reuse){
      for(var j = 0; j < shuffled.length; j++){
        if(!used[shuffled[j].id]) return shuffled[j];
      }
      if(!reuse) return null;
      // desktop reuse from the pool (landscapes are few; portraits may fill landscape frames)
      return shuffled[idx % shuffled.length];
    }

    // Decide how many slots to render.
    //   Desktop: round the pool size UP to a full 6-slot block (4P+2L) so rows never leave gaps.
    //   Mobile : render exactly one card per available video (original behaviour preserved).
    var slotCount;
    if(desktop){
      var blocks = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(shuffled.length / WORK_PATTERN.length));
      slotCount = blocks * WORK_PATTERN.length;
    } else {
      slotCount = shuffled.length;
    }

    var orderedList = []; // {p, slot}
    var used = {};
    for(var s = 0; s < slotCount; s++){
      var slot = WORK_PATTERN[orderedList.length % WORK_PATTERN.length];
      var picked;
      if(slot === 'L'){
        picked = pickAny(used, s, desktop);
      } else {
        picked = pickPortrait(used, desktop);
        // mobile fallback (original behaviour): if no unused portrait, take any unused video
        if(!picked && !desktop) picked = pickAny(used, s, false);
      }
      if(!picked) continue;
      used[picked.id] = true;
      orderedList.push({ p: picked, slot: slot });
      if(!desktop && orderedList.length >= shuffled.length) break;
    }

    // Split between top and bottom grids on a clean block boundary so each grid tiles perfectly.
    var splitAt;
    if(desktop){
      var blockLen = WORK_PATTERN.length; // 6
      var halfBlocks = Math.ceil((orderedList.length / blockLen) / 2);
      splitAt = Math.min(orderedList.length, halfBlocks * blockLen);
    } else {
      // Original mobile split: balance cell counts (landscape = 2 cells) to an even number.
      splitAt = Math.ceil(orderedList.length / 2);
      function safeSlotCount(count){
        var cells = 0;
        for(var i = 0; i < count; i++){ cells += (orderedList[i].slot === 'L') ? 2 : 1; }
        return cells;
      }
      while(splitAt > 0 && splitAt < orderedList.length && (safeSlotCount(splitAt) % 2 !== 0)){ splitAt++; }
    }

    function renderToGrid(grid, items){
      items.forEach(function(entry, i){
        var isWideSlot = (entry.slot === 'L');
        var cardClass = isWideSlot ? 'wc wide' : 'wc';
        var card = makeCard(entry.p, cardClass, "wc-name", "wc-cat", "wc-client");
        card.style.opacity = "0";
        card.style.transform = "translateY(16px)";
        card.style.transition = "opacity 0.5s ease " + (i * 0.06) + "s,transform 0.5s ease " + (i * 0.06) + "s";
        grid.appendChild(card);
        setTimeout(function(){ card.style.opacity = "1"; card.style.transform = "translateY(0)"; }, 50 + i * 60);
      });
    }

    renderToGrid(gridTop, orderedList.slice(0, splitAt));
    renderToGrid(gridBot, orderedList.slice(splitAt));
  }

  // STUDIO REELS — YOUTUBE SHORTS STYLE VIDEO PREVIEWS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  function buildReelCard(project, isLandscape, index) {
    var cls = 'sreel-card' + (isLandscape ? ' landscape' : '');
    var idx = index || 0;
    var thumbStyle = '';
    if (project.thumb) {
      thumbStyle = 'background-image:url(' + project.thumb + ');background-size:cover;background-position:center;';
    } else {
      thumbStyle = 'background:' + (project.clr || 'linear-gradient(160deg,#0a0a0a,#1a1a1a)') + ';';
    }
    var aspect = isLandscape ? '16/9' : '9/16';
    return '<div class="' + cls + '" style="--reel-i:' + idx + ';" onclick="openMByName(\'' + project.name.replace(/'/g,"\\'") + '\')">' +
      '<div class="sreel-card-thumb" style="' + thumbStyle + 'aspect-ratio:' + aspect + ';"></div>' +
      '<div class="sreel-card-gradient"></div>' +
      '<div class="sreel-card-play"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="8 5 19 12 8 19"/></svg></div>' +
      '<div class="sreel-card-badge"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 2C8 2 4 6 4 12s4 8 8 8c2 0 4-1 5.5-2.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3" fill="none"/><path d="M12 17c-3 0-5-1.5-5-3" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></div>' +
      '<div class="sreel-card-info">' +
        '<div class="sreel-card-title">' + project.name + '</div>' +
        (project.client ? '<div class="sreel-card-client">' + project.client + '</div>' : '') +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  function renderStudioReels() {
    if (!PROJECTS || PROJECTS.length === 0) return;

    // ── Orientation-aware, UNLIMITED dynamic reels ──
    // Rules:
    //   • Portrait videos are flexible — they can appear on BOTH portrait AND landscape cards
    //   • Landscape videos ONLY appear on landscape cards (they over-zoom on portrait cards)
    //   • NO LIMIT — every single video from Supabase/PROJECTS array is shown

    // Separate by orientation
    var allPortrait = PROJECTS.filter(function(p) {
      return p.aspect !== 'landscape' && p.aspect !== '16:9';
    });
    var allLandscape = PROJECTS.filter(function(p) {
      return p.aspect === 'landscape' || p.aspect === '16:9';
    });

    // Portrait card tracks: ONLY portrait videos (landscape looks bad here)
    // Shuffle for variety each render
    var portraitForPortraitCards = shuf(allPortrait.slice());

    // Landscape card tracks: ALL videos (portrait is flexible + landscape belongs here)
    var allForLandscapeCards = shuf(PROJECTS.slice());

    // ── Studio page — "From The Studio" portrait reel ──
    var portraitTrack = document.getElementById('studioReelPortrait');
    if (portraitTrack) {
      var html = '';
      portraitForPortraitCards.forEach(function(p, i) { html += buildReelCard(p, false, i); });
      portraitTrack.innerHTML = html;
      initSmoothAutoScroll('studioReelPortrait', 0.4);
    }

    // ── Studio page — "Cinema Reel" landscape reel ──
    var landscapeTrack = document.getElementById('studioReelLandscape');
    if (landscapeTrack) {
      var html2 = '';
      allForLandscapeCards.forEach(function(p, i) { html2 += buildReelCard(p, true, i); });
      landscapeTrack.innerHTML = html2;
      initSmoothAutoScroll('studioReelLandscape', 0.35);
    }

    // ── About page — "See It In Action" portrait reel ──
    var aboutReel = document.getElementById('aboutReelPortrait');
    if (aboutReel) {
      var html3 = '';
      // Re-shuffle for different order on about page
      var aboutPortrait = shuf(allPortrait.slice());
      aboutPortrait.forEach(function(p, i) { html3 += buildReelCard(p, false, i); });
      aboutReel.innerHTML = html3;
      initSmoothAutoScroll('aboutReelPortrait', 0.35);
    }

    // ── Community page — "What We Produce" landscape reel ──
    var commReel = document.getElementById('commReelLandscape');
    if (commReel) {
      var html4 = '';
      var commAll = shuf(PROJECTS.slice());
      commAll.forEach(function(p, i) { html4 += buildReelCard(p, true, i); });
      commReel.innerHTML = html4;
      initSmoothAutoScroll('commReelLandscape', 0.3);
    }
  }

  // Helper — open portrait player by project name
  function openMByName(name) {
    for (var i = 0; i < PROJECTS.length; i++) {
      if (PROJECTS[i].name === name) {
        if(PROJECTS[i].aspect === 'landscape' || PROJECTS[i].aspect === '16:9') {
          openLandscape(PROJECTS[i]);
        } else {
          openPortrait(PROJECTS[i]);
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  window.openMByName = openMByName;

  function openM(p){
    document.getElementById("mCat").textContent=p.cat.toUpperCase()+" PROJECT";
    document.getElementById("mTitle").textContent=p.name;
    document.getElementById("mDesc").textContent=p.desc;

    }else if(p.mp4){
      vid.innerHTML='<video controls autoplay style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#000;" src="'+p.mp4+'"></video>';
    }else{
      vid.innerHTML='<div class="modal-ph" style="background:'+p.clr+'"><span class="modal-ph-ico">&#9654;</span><div class="modal-ph-txt">Upload your video file and add the filename to see it play here</div></div>';
    }
    document.getElementById("modal").classList.add("open");
    document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
  }
  var mc=document.getElementById("mClose");

  if(mc) mc.addEventListener("click",closeM);

    var m=document.getElementById("modal");
    var v=document.getElementById("mVid");
    if(m) m.classList.remove("open");

  // CONTACT FORM → SUPABASE
  // ══════════════════════════════════
  var cf = document.getElementById("contactForm");
  if (cf) {
    cf.addEventListener("submit", function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var btn = document.getElementById("ctSubmitBtn");
      var form = this;
      var inputs = form.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea');
      var name = inputs[0] ? inputs[0].value.trim() : '';
      var whatsapp = inputs[1] ? inputs[1].value.trim() : '';
      var industry = inputs[2] ? inputs[2].value : '';
      var service = inputs[3] ? inputs[3].value : '';
      var message = inputs[4] ? inputs[4].value.trim() : '';

      if (!name || !whatsapp) {
        showFormToast('Please fill in your name and WhatsApp number.', false);
        return;
      }

      if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Sending...'; btn.disabled = true; }

      sbFetch('/rest/v1/contact_submissions', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: name,
          whatsapp: whatsapp,
          industry: industry,
          service: service,
          message: message,
          status: 'new'
        })
      })
      .then(function(res) {
        if (res.ok || res.status === 201) {
          if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Story Received! ✔'; btn.style.background = '#1E8449'; btn.disabled = false; }
          form.reset();
          showFormToast('Your story reached us. We reply within 24 hours.', true);
          setTimeout(function() {
            if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Send My Story →'; btn.style.background = ''; }
          }, 4000);
        } else {
          throw new Error('Server error ' + res.status);
        }
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Send My Story →'; btn.disabled = false; }
        showFormToast('Something went wrong. Please WhatsApp us directly.', false);
      });
    });
  }

      });

  function showFormToast(msg, success) {
    var existing = document.getElementById('formToast');
    if (existing) existing.remove();
    var t = document.createElement('div');
    t.id = 'formToast';
    t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:' +
      (success ? '#0a2a1a' : '#2a0a0a') + ';border:1px solid ' +
      (success ? 'rgba(0,255,100,0.3)' : 'rgba(214,0,0,0.4)') +
      ';color:' + (success ? '#00cc66' : '#ff4444') +
      ';padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-family:Orbitron,sans-serif;font-size:0.48rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;z-index:9999;text-align:center;max-width:300px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);';
    t.textContent = msg;
    document.body.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(function() { if(t.parentNode) t.parentNode.removeChild(t); }, 4000);
  }

  // Letter-by-letter title animation
  function animateCommTitle(){
    var letters = document.querySelectorAll('.comm-letter');
    letters.forEach(function(letter, i){
      setTimeout(function(){ letter.classList.add('revealed'); }, i * 120);
    });
  }

  // Counter animation with number roll
  function animateCounter(el){
    var target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-target'));
    var suffix = el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '';
    var duration = 2000;
    var start = 0;
    var startTime = null;
    function step(timestamp){
      if(!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
      var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3); // easeOutCubic
      var current = Math.floor(eased * target);
      el.textContent = current.toLocaleString() + suffix;
      if(progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  // Observe community section for title animation
  var commTitleObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        animateCommTitle();
        commTitleObs.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold: 0.3});
  var commTitleEl = document.getElementById('commTitle');
  if(commTitleEl) commTitleObs.observe(commTitleEl);

  // Observe counters
  var counterObs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        var nums = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.comm-stat-num');
        nums.forEach(function(n){ animateCounter(n); });
        counterObs.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold: 0.3});
  var counterStrip = document.querySelector('.comm-counter-strip');
  if(counterStrip) counterObs.observe(counterStrip);

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // VIDEO PROGRESS BAR — YOUTUBE-STYLE SEEK + BUFFER
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  function formatTime(s){
    if(!s || isNaN(s) || !isFinite(s)) return '0:00';
    var m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    var sec = Math.floor(s % 60);
    return m + ':' + (sec < 10 ? '0' : '') + sec;
  }

  function initProgressBar(video, wrapId, bufBarId, playBarId, thumbId, timeId){
    var wrap = document.getElementById(wrapId);
    var bufBar = document.getElementById(bufBarId);
    var playBar = document.getElementById(playBarId);
    var thumb = document.getElementById(thumbId);
    var timeDisp = document.getElementById(timeId);
    if(!wrap || !video) return null;

    var isDragging = false;
    var rafId = null;

    function updateBar(){
      if(!video || !video.duration || isNaN(video.duration)) return;
      var dur = video.duration;
      var cur = video.currentTime;
      var playPct = (cur / dur) * 100;
      if(playBar) playBar.style.width = playPct + '%';
      if(thumb) thumb.style.left = playPct + '%';
      if(timeDisp) timeDisp.innerHTML = formatTime(cur) + ' <span>/</span> ' + formatTime(dur);

      // Buffer bar
      if(video.buffered && video.buffered.length > 0){
        var buffEnd = 0;
        for(var i = 0; i < video.buffered.length; i++){
          if(video.buffered.start(i) <= cur && video.buffered.end(i) > buffEnd){
            buffEnd = video.buffered.end(i);
          }
        }
        var bufPct = (buffEnd / dur) * 100;
        if(bufBar) bufBar.style.width = bufPct + '%';
      }
    }

    function tick(){
      if(!isDragging) updateBar();
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    function seekTo(e){
      var rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      var x = (e.touches ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX) - rect.left;
      var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x / rect.width));
      if(video.duration && isFinite(video.duration)){
        video.currentTime = pct * video.duration;
        if(playBar) playBar.style.width = (pct * 100) + '%';
        if(thumb) thumb.style.left = (pct * 100) + '%';
      }
    }

    function onDown(e){
      isDragging = true;
      seekTo(e);
      e.preventDefault();
    }
    function onMove(e){
      if(isDragging){ seekTo(e); e.preventDefault(); }
    }
    function onUp(){
      isDragging = false;
    }

    wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
    wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', onDown, {passive:false});
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, {passive:false});
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    document.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

    return {
      show: function(){ wrap.style.display = 'block'; },
      hide: function(){ wrap.style.display = 'none'; },
      reset: function(){
        if(playBar) playBar.style.width = '0%';
        if(bufBar) bufBar.style.width = '0%';
        if(thumb) thumb.style.left = '0%';
        if(timeDisp) timeDisp.innerHTML = '0:00 <span>/</span> 0:00';
      },
      destroy: function(){
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        wrap.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
        wrap.removeEventListener('touchstart', onDown);
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
        document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
        document.removeEventListener('touchend', onUp);
        wrap.style.display = 'none';
      }
    };
  }

  // Global references for progress bars
  window._ptProgressBar = null;
  window._lsProgressBar = null;

  // ── Buffer-aware playback utility ──
  // Returns how many seconds of video are buffered ahead of current position
  function getBufferLead(video){
    if(!video || !video.buffered || video.buffered.length === 0) return 0;
    var cur = video.currentTime;
    for(var i = 0; i < video.buffered.length; i++){
      if(video.buffered.start(i) <= cur + 0.1 && video.buffered.end(i) > cur){
        return video.buffered.end(i) - cur;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }

  // Minimum buffer (seconds) required before playback starts or resumes
  // Higher values = smoother playback (more runway before hitting buffer boundary)
  var MIN_BUFFER_START = 2;
  var MIN_BUFFER_RESUME = 1;

  // View counts (simulated with localStorage persistence)
  var ptViews = {};
  try { ptViews = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bdz_views') || '{}'); } catch(e){}
  function ptSaveViews(){ try { localStorage.setItem('bdz_views', JSON.stringify(ptViews)); } catch(e){} }
  function getViewCount(id) {
    var base = {1:1247,2:892,3:2341,4:673,5:1102,6:534,7:887,8:723,9:1056};
    return (base[id]||500) + (ptViews[id]||0);
  }
  function formatViews(n) {
    if(n >= 1000) return (n/1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return n.toString();
  }

  // Particle system for portrait modal
  function startParticles() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('ptParticles');
    if(!canvas) return;
    var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    var particles = [];
    var goldColor = ptCurrent ? ptCurrent.glow : '#EFB20C';
    
    for(var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        vy: -Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.1,
        size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
        alpha: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1,
        life: Math.random() * 200 + 100
      });
    }
    
    function animate() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(function(p) {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.life--;
        if(p.life <= 0 || p.y < -10) {
          p.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
          p.y = canvas.height + 10;
          p.life = Math.random() * 200 + 100;
          p.alpha = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = goldColor;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * (p.life > 30 ? 1 : p.life / 30);
        ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ptParticleAnim = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
  }
  
  function stopParticles() {
    if(ptParticleAnim) { cancelAnimationFrame(ptParticleAnim); ptParticleAnim = null; }
    var canvas = document.getElementById('ptParticles');
    if(canvas) { var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); }
  }

  function openPortrait(p) {
    document.body.classList.add('video-playing');
    ptCurrent = p;
    // Increment view count
    ptViews[p.id] = (ptViews[p.id] || 0) + 1;
    ptSaveViews();
    
    var bg = document.getElementById('ptCardBg');
    if(bg) bg.style.background = p.clr;
    var vbd = document.getElementById('ptVideoBackdrop');
    if(vbd){
      if(p.thumb){ vbd.style.background = '#000'; vbd.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + p.thumb + '")'; }
      else { vbd.style.backgroundImage = 'none'; vbd.style.background = p.clr; }
    }
    var glow = document.getElementById('ptCardGlow');
    if(glow) glow.style.background = p.glow;
    var glow2 = document.getElementById('ptCardGlow2');
    if(glow2) glow2.style.background = p.glow;
    
    var el = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
    var catLabel = (p.cat||'').replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase();
    var c = el('ptCat'); if(c) c.textContent = catLabel + ' PROJECT';
    var t = el('ptTitle'); if(t) t.textContent = p.name;
    var cl = el('ptClient'); if(cl) cl.textContent = p.client;
    var d = el('ptDesc'); if(d) d.textContent = p.desc;
    
    // Update view count
    var vc = el('ptViewsCount');
    if(vc) vc.textContent = formatViews(getViewCount(p.id)) + ' views';
    
    // Update project counter
    var counter = el('ptCounter');
    if(counter) {
      var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
      var idx = -1;
      for(var i=0;i<navList.length;i++){ if(navList[i].id === p.id){ idx=i; break; }}
      counter.innerHTML = '<span>' + String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span> / ' + String(navList.length).padStart(2,'0');
    }
    
    // ── VIDEO PLAYER (Bunny Stream via HLS.js) — IMPROVED BUFFERING ──
    var video = el('ptVideo');
    var playBtn = el('ptPlayBtn');
    var muteBtn = el('ptMuteBtn');

    // Destroy previous HLS instance and progress bar
    if(window._hlsInstance) {
      window._hlsInstance.destroy();
      window._hlsInstance = null;
    }
    if(window._ptProgressBar) {
      window._ptProgressBar.destroy();
      window._ptProgressBar = null;
    }

    if(video) {
      video.onwaiting = null;
      video.onstalled = null;
      video.onplaying = null;
      video.ontimeupdate = null;
      video.pause();
      video.removeAttribute('src');
      video.load();
      video.style.display = 'none';
      var loader = el('ptLoader');
      if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
      if(playBtn) { playBtn.style.display = ''; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;'; }
      if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';
      if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }

      var hasVideo = p.hls || p.mp4;
      if(hasVideo) {
        video.style.display = 'block';
        video.muted = true;
        video.loop = true;

        // Initialize progress bar for this video
        window._ptProgressBar = initProgressBar(video, 'ptProgressWrap', 'ptBufferBar', 'ptPlayBar', 'ptThumb', 'ptTimeDisplay');
        if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.reset();

        // Handle stalling — let HLS.js ABR handle quality automatically
        video.onwaiting = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
          if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
          // Start monitoring buffer — only resume when enough buffer has rebuilt
          if(window._ptBufferMonitor) clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor);
          window._ptBufferMonitor = setInterval(function(){
            var lead = getBufferLead(video);
            if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_RESUME){
              clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor);
              window._ptBufferMonitor = null;
              video.play().then(function(){
                if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              }).catch(function(){});
            }
          }, 300);
        };
        video.onplaying = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
          if(playBtn) { playBtn.style.display = 'none'; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;'; }
          if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; }
          if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
          if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }
        };

        // Show branded loader during initial load
        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
        if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';

        // Use HLS.js for .m3u8 streams (Bunny Stream) — BUFFER-AWARE PLAYBACK
        if(p.hls && Hls.isSupported()) {
          var hls = new Hls({
            startLevel: -1,
            capLevelToPlayerSize: true,
            maxBufferLength: 15,
            maxMaxBufferLength: 30,
            maxBufferSize: 10 * 1000 * 1000,
            maxBufferHole: 0.3,
            backBufferLength: 30,
            lowLatencyMode: false,
            abrEwmaDefaultEstimate: 1000000,
            abrBandWidthFactor: 0.95,
            abrBandWidthUpFactor: 0.7,
            enableWorker: true,
            fragLoadingTimeOut: 20000,
            fragLoadingMaxRetry: 6,
            fragLoadingRetryDelay: 1000,
            levelLoadingTimeOut: 15000,
            startFragPrefetch: true,
            testBandwidth: true,
            stretchShortVideoTrack: true,
            nudgeOffset: 0.2,
            nudgeMaxRetry: 5
          });
          hls.loadSource(p.hls);
          hls.attachMedia(video);
          hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, function(){
            // Let HLS.js ABR auto-select best quality (startLevel: -1)
            // Wait for buffer to build before starting playback
            var ptStartCheck = setInterval(function(){
              var lead = getBufferLead(video);
              if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_START){
                clearInterval(ptStartCheck);
                video.play().then(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
                  if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._ptResetMuteIcon(); }
                  if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
                }).catch(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
                });
              }
            }, 300);
          });

          hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, function(event, data){
            if(data.fatal) {
              switch(data.type) {
                case Hls.ErrorTypes.NETWORK_ERROR:
                  hls.startLoad(); // try to recover network
                  break;
                case Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR:
                  hls.recoverMediaError(); // try to recover media
                  break;
                default:
                  // Fall back to MP4 if HLS completely fails
                  if(p.mp4) {
                    hls.destroy();
                    video.src = p.mp4;
                    video.load();
                    video.play().catch(function(){});
                  }
                  break;
              }
            }
          });
          window._hlsInstance = hls;
        }
        // Native HLS support (Safari/iOS)
        else if(p.hls && video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
          video.src = p.hls;
          video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._ptResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
            });
          }, 500);
        }
        // Direct MP4 fallback
        else if(p.mp4) {
          video.src = p.mp4;
          video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._ptResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
            });
          }, 500);
        }
      } else {
        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
        if(window._ptProgressBar) window._ptProgressBar.hide();
      }
    }

    // Close description by default
    var desc = el('ptDesc');
    var descToggle = el('ptDescToggle');
    if(desc) desc.classList.remove('open');
    if(descToggle) descToggle.classList.remove('open');

    // Also show thumbnail as background while video loads
    if(p.thumb && bg) {
      bg.style.background = 'url(' + p.thumb + ') center/cover no-repeat';
    } else {
      if(bg) bg.style.background = p.clr;
    }
    
    // Enhanced meta
    var meta = el('ptMeta');
    if(meta){
      var metaHTML = '';
      if(p.duration) metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#9201;</span> '+p.duration+'</span>';
      metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#127916;</span> 100% AI</span>';
      if(p.badge_txt) metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">'+(BADGE_ICONS[p.badge]||'')+'</span> '+p.badge_txt+'</span>';
      meta.innerHTML = metaHTML;
    }
    var tools = el('ptTools');
    if(tools && p.tools){
      tools.innerHTML = p.tools.map(function(t){ return '<span class="pt-tool">'+t+'</span>'; }).join('');
    }
    ptUpdateLike(p.id);
    ptUpdateComment(p.id);
    
    // Show swipe hint on first visit
    var hint = el('ptSwipeHint');
    if(hint) {
      var seen = localStorage.getItem('bdz_swipe_seen');
      if(!seen) {
        hint.style.display = '';
        hint.style.animation = 'ptSwipeHint 3s ease 1.5s forwards';
        localStorage.setItem('bdz_swipe_seen', '1');
      } else {
        hint.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
    
    var m = el('ptModal');
    var _wasAlreadyOpen = m && m.classList.contains('open');
    if(m){ m.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
    
    // Push state so back button closes modal instead of leaving page — only once per open
    if(!_wasAlreadyOpen && !_ptModalHistoryPushed){
      history.pushState({ modal: 'portrait' }, '', _bdzHashUrl('bdz-player'));
      _ptModalHistoryPushed = true;
    }
    
    // Start particle animation
    setTimeout(startParticles, 300);
  }

  // Immediately stop current video playback and destroy HLS to free bandwidth
  function stopCurrentVideo() {
    document.body.classList.remove('video-playing');
    if(window._hlsInstance) { window._hlsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsInstance = null; }
    if(window._hlsLsInstance) { window._hlsLsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsLsInstance = null; }
    if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }
    if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }
    var ptVid = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
    if(ptVid) { ptVid.pause(); ptVid.removeAttribute('src'); ptVid.load(); }
    var lsVid = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
    if(lsVid) { lsVid.pause(); lsVid.removeAttribute('src'); lsVid.load(); }
  }

  // NEXT / PREV project navigation with cinematic transition
  window.nextProject = function(){
    if(!ptCurrent && !lsCurrent) return;
    stopCurrentVideo();
    var currentProject = ptCurrent || lsCurrent;
    var idx = -1;
    for(var i=0;i<current.length;i++){ if(current[i].id === currentProject.id){ idx=i; break; }}
    if(idx === -1){ for(var i=0;i<PROJECTS.length;i++){ if(PROJECTS[i].id === currentProject.id){ idx=i; break; }} }
    var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
    var next = navList[(idx+1)%navList.length];
    var isLandscapeNext = (next.aspect === 'landscape' || next.aspect === '16:9');
    var isCurrentPortraitModal = !!ptCurrent;
    // If switching modal type, close current and open new — transfer history entry
    if(isCurrentPortraitModal && isLandscapeNext){
      _closingViaPopstate = true; // prevent history.back() on close
      closePortrait();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      _lsModalHistoryPushed = true; // transfer history ownership to landscape modal
      setTimeout(function(){ openLandscape(next); }, 100);
      return;
    }
    if(!isCurrentPortraitModal && !isLandscapeNext){
      _closingViaPopstate = true; // prevent history.back() on close
      closeLandscape();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      _ptModalHistoryPushed = true; // transfer history ownership to portrait modal
      setTimeout(function(){ openPortrait(next); }, 100);
      return;
    }
    // Same modal type — animate transition
    if(isCurrentPortraitModal){
      var card = document.querySelector('.pt-modal-card');
      if(card){
        card.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        card.style.transform = 'translateY(-30px)';
        card.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function(){
          openPortrait(next);
          card.style.transition = 'none';
          card.style.transform = 'translateY(30px)';
          card.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(function(){
            card.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            card.style.transform = '';
            card.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openPortrait(next); }
    } else {
      var lsCard = document.querySelector('.ls-modal-card');
      if(lsCard){
        lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(30px)';
        lsCard.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(function(){
          openLandscape(next);
          lsCard.style.transition = 'none';
          lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(-30px)';
          lsCard.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(function(){
            lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            lsCard.style.transform = '';
            lsCard.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openLandscape(next); }
    }
  };

            card.style.transform = '';
            card.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);
      } else { openPortrait(prev); }
    } else {

      if(lsCard){
        lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s ease-in, opacity 0.25s ease-in';
        lsCard.style.transform = 'translateX(-30px)';

            lsCard.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 0.3s ease';
            lsCard.style.transform = '';
            lsCard.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 30);
        }, 260);

    }
  };

  function closePortrait() {
    document.body.classList.remove('video-playing');
    // Destroy HLS instance
    if(window._hlsInstance) { window._hlsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsInstance = null; }
    // Destroy progress bar
    if(window._ptProgressBar) { window._ptProgressBar.destroy(); window._ptProgressBar = null; }
    // Clear buffer monitor
    if(window._ptBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._ptBufferMonitor); window._ptBufferMonitor = null; }
    // Stop video
    var video = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
    if(video) { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); video.style.display = 'none'; }
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('ptPlayBtn');
    if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
    var muteBtn = document.getElementById('ptMuteBtn');
    if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';
    var loader = document.getElementById('ptLoader');
    if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';

    var m = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    if(m){ m.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
    closeShareSheet();
    stopParticles();
    ptCurrent = null;
    // If closed via UI (not back button), consume the history entry
    var hadHistory = _ptModalHistoryPushed;
    _ptModalHistoryPushed = false;
    if(hadHistory && !_closingViaPopstate){ history.back(); }
  }
  // Expose to window for onclick handlers
  window.closePortrait = closePortrait;

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  // LANDSCAPE MODAL — OPEN / CLOSE / CONTROLS
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════
  function openLandscape(p) {
    document.body.classList.add('video-playing');
    lsCurrent = p;
    ptViews[p.id] = (ptViews[p.id] || 0) + 1;
    ptSaveViews();

    var el = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
    var bg = el('lsCardBg');
    if(p.thumb && bg) { bg.style.background = 'url(' + p.thumb + ') center/cover no-repeat'; }
    else if(bg) { bg.style.background = p.clr; }

    var catLabel = (p.cat||'').replace(/_/g,' ').toUpperCase();
    var c = el('lsCat'); if(c) c.textContent = catLabel + ' PROJECT';
    var t = el('lsTitle'); if(t) t.textContent = p.name;
    var cl = el('lsClient'); if(cl) cl.textContent = p.client;
    var d = el('lsDesc'); if(d) d.textContent = p.desc;

    var vc = el('lsViewsCount');
    if(vc) vc.textContent = formatViews(getViewCount(p.id)) + ' views';

    var counter = el('lsCounter');
    if(counter) {
      var navList = current.length > 0 ? current : PROJECTS;
      var idx = -1;
      for(var i=0;i<navList.length;i++){ if(navList[i].id === p.id){ idx=i; break; }}
      counter.innerHTML = '<span>' + String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0') + '</span> / ' + String(navList.length).padStart(2,'0');
    }

    var meta = el('lsMeta');
    if(meta){
      var metaHTML = '';
      if(p.duration) metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#9201;</span> '+p.duration+'</span>';
      metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#127916;</span> 100% AI</span>';
      metaHTML += '<span class="pt-meta-tag"><span class="pt-meta-tag-ico">&#128250;</span> 16:9 Widescreen</span>';
      meta.innerHTML = metaHTML;
    }

    var desc = el('lsDesc');
    var descToggle = el('lsDescToggle');
    if(desc) desc.classList.remove('open');
    if(descToggle) descToggle.classList.remove('open');

    // Update like/comment counts for landscape action bar
    lsUpdateLike(p.id);
    lsUpdateComment(p.id);

    // ── VIDEO PLAYER (Bunny Stream via HLS.js) — IMPROVED BUFFERING ──
    var video = el('lsVideo');
    var playBtn = el('lsPlayBtn');
    var muteBtn = el('lsMuteBtn');

    if(window._hlsLsInstance) { window._hlsLsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsLsInstance = null; }
    if(window._lsProgressBar) { window._lsProgressBar.destroy(); window._lsProgressBar = null; }
    if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }

    if(video) {
      video.onwaiting = null;
      video.onstalled = null;
      video.onplaying = null;
      video.ontimeupdate = null;
      video.pause();
      video.removeAttribute('src');
      video.load();
      video.style.display = 'none';
      var loader = el('lsLoader');
      if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
      if(playBtn) { playBtn.style.display = ''; playBtn.innerHTML = '&#9654;'; }
      if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';

      var hasVideo = p.hls || p.mp4;
      if(hasVideo) {
        video.style.display = 'block';
        video.muted = true;
        video.loop = true;

        // Initialize progress bar for this video
        window._lsProgressBar = initProgressBar(video, 'lsProgressWrap', 'lsBufferBar', 'lsPlayBar', 'lsThumb', 'lsTimeDisplay');
        if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.reset();

        video.onwaiting = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
          if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
          if(window._lsBufferMonitor) clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor);
          window._lsBufferMonitor = setInterval(function(){
            var lead = getBufferLead(video);
            if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_RESUME){
              clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor);
              window._lsBufferMonitor = null;
              video.play().then(function(){
                if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
              }).catch(function(){});
            }
          }, 300);
        };
        video.onplaying = function(){
          if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
          if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
          if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
          if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
          if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }
        };

        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'flex';
        if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';

        if(p.hls && Hls.isSupported()) {
          var hls = new Hls({
            startLevel: -1, capLevelToPlayerSize: true,
            maxBufferLength: 15, maxMaxBufferLength: 30,
            maxBufferSize: 10*1000*1000, maxBufferHole: 0.3,
            backBufferLength: 30, lowLatencyMode: false,
            abrEwmaDefaultEstimate: 1000000,
            abrBandWidthFactor: 0.95, abrBandWidthUpFactor: 0.7,
            enableWorker: true,
            fragLoadingTimeOut: 20000, fragLoadingMaxRetry: 6,
            fragLoadingRetryDelay: 1000,
            levelLoadingTimeOut: 15000, startFragPrefetch: true,
            testBandwidth: true,
            stretchShortVideoTrack: true,
            nudgeOffset: 0.2,
            nudgeMaxRetry: 5
          });
          hls.loadSource(p.hls);
          hls.attachMedia(video);
          hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, function(){
            // Let HLS.js ABR auto-select best quality
            var lsStartCheck = setInterval(function(){
              var lead = getBufferLead(video);
              if(lead >= MIN_BUFFER_START){
                clearInterval(lsStartCheck);
                video.play().then(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
                  if(muteBtn) { muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
                  if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
                }).catch(function(){
                  if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
                  if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
                });
              }
            }, 300);
          });
          hls.on(Hls.Events.ERROR, function(event, data){
            if(data.fatal){
              if(data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.NETWORK_ERROR) hls.startLoad();
              else if(data.type === Hls.ErrorTypes.MEDIA_ERROR) hls.recoverMediaError();
              else if(p.mp4){ hls.destroy(); video.src = p.mp4; video.load(); video.play().catch(function(){}); }
            }
          });
          window._hlsLsInstance = hls;
        }
        else if(p.hls && video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
          video.src = p.hls; video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn){ muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){ if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = ''; });
          }, 500);
        }
        else if(p.mp4) {
          video.src = p.mp4; video.load();
          setTimeout(function(){
            video.play().then(function(){
              if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if(muteBtn){ muteBtn.style.display = 'flex'; window._lsResetMuteIcon(); }
              if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.show();
            }).catch(function(){ if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = ''; });
          }, 500);
        }
      } else {
        if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
        if(window._lsProgressBar) window._lsProgressBar.hide();
      }
    }

    var m = el('lsModal');
    var _lsWasAlreadyOpen = m && m.classList.contains('open');
    if(m){ m.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
    if(!_lsWasAlreadyOpen && !_lsModalHistoryPushed){
      history.pushState({ modal: 'landscape' }, '', _bdzHashUrl('bdz-player'));
      _lsModalHistoryPushed = true;
    }
  }

  function closeLandscape() {
    document.body.classList.remove('video-playing');
    if(window._hlsLsInstance) { window._hlsLsInstance.destroy(); window._hlsLsInstance = null; }
    if(window._lsProgressBar) { window._lsProgressBar.destroy(); window._lsProgressBar = null; }
    if(window._lsBufferMonitor) { clearInterval(window._lsBufferMonitor); window._lsBufferMonitor = null; }
    var video = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
    if(video) { video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load(); video.style.display = 'none'; }
    var playBtn = document.getElementById('lsPlayBtn');
    if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
    var muteBtn = document.getElementById('lsMuteBtn');
    if(muteBtn) muteBtn.style.display = 'none';
    var loader = document.getElementById('lsLoader');
    if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none';
    var m = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    if(m){ m.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
    var hadHistory = _lsModalHistoryPushed;
    _lsModalHistoryPushed = false;
    if(hadHistory && !_closingViaPopstate){ history.back(); }
    lsCurrent = null;
  }
  window.closeLandscape = closeLandscape;
  window.openLandscape = openLandscape;

  window.toggleLsMute = function() {
    var video = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
    var btn = document.getElementById('lsMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('lsMuteSvg');
    var hint = document.getElementById('lsMuteHint');
    if(!video || !btn || !svg) return;
    video.muted = !video.muted;
    if(video.muted){
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
      btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    } else {
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"/><path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"/>';
      btn.classList.add('unmuted');
      if(hint) hint.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };
  window._lsResetMuteIcon = function(){
    var btn = document.getElementById('lsMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('lsMuteSvg');
    if(btn) btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    if(svg) svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
  };

    if(toggle) toggle.classList.toggle('open');
  };

  // Landscape modal — tap to play/pause
  var lsVideoArea = document.getElementById('lsVideoArea');
  if(lsVideoArea) {
    lsVideoArea.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var video = document.getElementById('lsVideo');
      var playBtn = document.getElementById('lsPlayBtn');
      var loader = document.getElementById('lsLoader');
      if(video && video.src && video.src !== window.location.href) {
        if(video.paused) {
          video.play().then(function(){ if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = 'none'; if(loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; }).catch(function(){});
        } else {
          video.pause(); if(playBtn) playBtn.style.display = '';
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Landscape modal — close handlers
  var lsCloseEl = document.getElementById('lsClose');
  if(lsCloseEl) lsCloseEl.addEventListener('click', closeLandscape);
  var lsBgEl = document.getElementById('lsModal');
  if(lsBgEl) lsBgEl.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===this) closeLandscape(); });

  // Landscape modal — swipe left/right OR up/down for next/prev
  var lsTouchStartX = 0;
  var lsTouchStartY = 0;
  var lsModalSwipe = document.getElementById('lsModal');
  if(lsModalSwipe) {
    lsModalSwipe.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      lsTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      lsTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    }, {passive: true});
    lsModalSwipe.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      var dx = lsTouchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      var dy = lsTouchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
      var absDx = Math.abs(dx);
      var absDy = Math.abs(dy);
      // Require minimum 50px swipe in dominant direction
      if(absDx > 50 && absDx > absDy) {
        // Horizontal swipe
        if(dx > 0) nextProject(); // Swipe left = next
        else prevProject(); // Swipe right = prev
      } else if(absDy > 50 && absDy > absDx) {
        // Vertical swipe
        if(dy > 0) nextProject(); // Swipe up = next
        else prevProject(); // Swipe down = prev
      }
    }, {passive: true});
  }

  // Back button closes modal instead of leaving the page
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function(e) {
    _closingViaPopstate = true;
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    if(lb && lb.classList.contains('open')) {
      closeReviewLightbox();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      return;
    }
    var lsM = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    if(lsM && lsM.classList.contains('open')) {
      closeLandscape();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      return;
    }
    var m = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    if(m && m.classList.contains('open')) {
      closePortrait();
      _closingViaPopstate = false;
      return;
    }
    _closingViaPopstate = false;
  });

  // Chrome Android fallback: hashchange fires when back button removes #bdz-player/#bdz-review
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', function() {
    var h = window.location.hash;
    if(h === '#bdz-player' || h === '#bdz-review') return;
    _closingViaPopstate = true;
    var lb = document.getElementById('reviewLightbox');
    if(lb && lb.classList.contains('open')) { closeReviewLightbox(); _closingViaPopstate = false; return; }
    var lsM = document.getElementById('lsModal');
    if(lsM && lsM.classList.contains('open')) { closeLandscape(); _closingViaPopstate = false; return; }
    var m = document.getElementById('ptModal');
    if(m && m.classList.contains('open')) { closePortrait(); _closingViaPopstate = false; return; }
    _closingViaPopstate = false;
  });

  // Mute / Unmute toggle
  window.toggleMute = function() {
    var video = document.getElementById('ptVideo');
    var btn = document.getElementById('ptMuteBtn');
    var svg = document.getElementById('ptMuteSvg');
    var hint = document.getElementById('ptMuteHint');
    if(!video || !btn || !svg) return;
    video.muted = !video.muted;
    if(video.muted){
      // Muted icon — speaker with X
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><line x1="23" y1="9" x2="17" y2="15"/><line x1="17" y1="9" x2="23" y2="15"/>';
      btn.classList.remove('unmuted');
    } else {
      // Unmuted icon — speaker with sound waves
      svg.innerHTML = '<polygon points="11 5 6 9 2 9 2 15 6 15 11 19 11 5"/><path d="M19.07 4.93a10 10 0 0 1 0 14.14"/><path d="M15.54 8.46a5 5 0 0 1 0 7.07"/>';
      btn.classList.add('unmuted');
      // Kill the hint once sound is on
      if(hint) hint.style.display = 'none';
    }
  };

  // Helper: reset mute button to "muted" visual state (used when a new video auto-plays muted)
